title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
**Senior Scrum Master** 




  





**Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India \- Hybrid (3 days onsite)
 



  





**Salary** 
 : 19\-23 LPA
 



  





**Shift** 
 : 1pm \- 10pm IST
 



  





**Duration** 
 : 12 month contract with potential for extension
 



  





**Joining Date: Immediate start date** 




  





**Essential Job Functions:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree Computer Science, Engineering, Technical Discipline or related field of study or equivalent, relevant work experience CSM/PSM
* 5\-8 years of experience as Scrum Master/Project Manager, including Capacity Management, Demand Management, Design Sprint, Iterative Design, Lean Agile, Kanban, Metrics Development, Visual Management.
* Experience with large\-scale Agile frameworks such as SAFe or LeSS
* Strong understanding in Jira



  





**Preferred Experience:** 



* Scrum Master Certification (CSM or PSM 1\)
* Agile coaching



 The Senior Scrum Master is a servant leader responsible for driving Agile best practices and Scrum methodology within a team. They coach, educate, and mentor Scrum Team members and less experienced Scrum Masters, fostering Agile proficiency throughout the organization. A key responsibility is removing impediments, ensuring smooth team operations while guiding external interactions to optimize efficiency. They champion agility and continuous improvement, utilizing frameworks such as Lean and Kanban to enhance workflow. Through self\-organization, they empower teams to work autonomously and maximize their potential. Additionally, they cultivate a safe, collaborative environment, where team members can raise concerns, ask questions, and engage in problem\-solving without fear of judgment. Their leadership drives innovation, adaptability, and overall organizational success.
 



  





**Essential Job Functions** 



* Coaching teams in Agile principles to achieve high performance through strong communication and servant leadership. Responsibilities include facilitating Scrum ceremonies, removing impediments, and fostering collaboration. They promote self\-organization, use Visual Management Systems, and drive continuous improvement to enhance team productivity and Agile maturity. \- (20%)
* Ensures the Product Owner is enabled to prioritize and maintain a clear and concise Product Backlog. Ensures the team understands the business case, scope, milestones, sprint goals, and other necessary information to produce the desired business value. Facilitates work completion without coercion, assigning or dictating the work. \- (20%)
* Supports organizational and Scrum Practice vision and standards to achieve goals. Leads the activities and initiatives of the Scrum COE. Seeks opportunities for improvement to improve the overall effectiveness of Scrum within the organization. Champions Agile and Scrum across the organization through various forums leveraging effective communication skills. \- (15%)
* Work closely with leaders from various departments, including Technology, Development, QA, and Product Management, to foster alignment and drive progress toward achieving organizational objectives. \- (15%)
* Maintain consistent communication at suitable intervals while following established business processes. Facilitate prompt team interactions with internal departments and clients to address concerns, updates, and modifications. Craft clear and timely email notifications and responses for cross\-functional and internal teams. \- (15%)
* Drive the continuous improvement of Scrum processes, both within teams and across the organization, with a focus on improving efficiency, quality, and delivery. \- (15%)

title: Scrum Master
description:
The Scrum Master is a servant leader who helps teams with meeting their delivery goals. The Scrum Master helps teams self\-organize, self\-manage, and deliver via effective Agile practices. The Scrum Master supports and enforces the rules of the Scrum process and other rules that the team has agreed upon. The Scrum Master also helps the team coordinate with other teams and communicates status to management as needed.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Act as liaison and point of contact between team and other stakeholders.
 



 • Provide reporting on team activities as required (development burndown, team velocity, etc.)
 



 • Work with business/product owners to groom the team backlog of work.
 



 • Monitor team workflow and removes obstacles as needed.
 



 • May coordinate release management planning and execution.
 



 • Coordinate team Product Iteration planning activities.
 



 • Manage the process for creating and managing task cards (Jira issues).
 



 • Create and manage sprint ceremony meetings (sprint planning, sprint retrospectives, demos, etc.).
 



 • Ensures compliance with quality control processes.
 



 • Monitors performance of team processes and initiates process improvements as required.
 



 • Cultivates and supports a culture of learning and teaching.
 



 • Assists in evaluating team performance during project progress.
 



 • Provides input in hiring decisions and performance evaluations.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Four years’ previous experience in Agile software development environments with one year working in the Scrum Master role preferred.
 



 • Excellent servant leadership skills.
 



 • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
 



 • Must have good communication and interpersonal skills to resolve problems.
 



 • Must have good time management and organizational skills.
 



 • In lieu of the specified education and experience requirements, a proven capability to perform the essential functions of the job, as demonstrated by an equivalent combination of education, training and/or relevant work experience may be considered.

title: Scrum Master, AVP
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master
   

  

* We’re looking for an experienced Scrum Master to drive a culture of continuous improvement
* You’ll make sure that your team lives by the values of Scrum, empowering them to become high performing to increase the productivity, as well as frequency and quality of delivery
* Hone your project skills as you work with talented people in collaborative and innovative environment, with access to the bank's Agile community, experts and events
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 This role will see you coaching and guiding your team to perform at their highest level and at a sustainable pace. You’ll remove any impediments to progress, facilitate meetings, protect the team from outside influences or distractions and work with the product owner to make sure that the product backlog is in good shape and ready for the next sprint.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Making sure the Scrum team understands Agile practices, the Scrum framework and values, and that the team uses this framework to deliver working software to satisfy platform customers and react to their needs quickly
* Transforming the Scrum team to become self\-organising to reduce management overhead costs, using techniques such as Systems and Lean thinking
* Acting as the process owner for the team, and maintaining relationships with the project's key stakeholders
* Creating a great place to work with a culture of safety and continuous improvement, through great people leadership, coaching, engagement and development of skills


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We're looking for someone with experience of successful Scrum adoption along with a Scrum Master certification. You'll need knowledge of modern development practices and tools, as well as a background in coaching cross\-functional teams into high performing teams.
   

  

 You’ll also need knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency, as well as experience of building a culture of transparency within feature teams by empowering individuals and inspiring a collaborative team performance.
   

  

**We'll Look To You To Demonstrate**
* Experience working as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum, Agile frameworks, and SAFe practices.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex technology initiatives
* Experience of automated testing frameworks

 We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support BCM application development teams by driving Agile delivery discipline, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, removing impediments, and ensuring delivery transparency. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Agile execution, stakeholder coordination, automotive software development processes, and delivery governance across distributed teams.

* Drive adherence to engineering processes, quality expectations, configuration management practices, and customer\-specific delivery governance.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance team productivity, predictability, quality, and Agile maturity.

* Strong working experience as Scrum Master, Agile Lead, Project Lead, or Delivery Coordinator in software development programs.
* Good understanding of Agile Scrum framework, sprint execution, backlog management, estimation techniques, and Agile metrics.
* Experience working with automotive embedded software development teams, preferably in BCM, body electronics, vehicle applications, ECU software, or related domains.
* Familiarity with automotive software development lifecycle, requirement analysis, software design, integration, validation, defect management, and release processes.
* Working knowledge of tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Polarion, DOORS, or equivalent Agile and requirements management tools.
* Experience in coordinating with distributed teams across offshore, onsite, customer, supplier, and OEM environments.
* Understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, diagnostics, CAN/LIN communication, configuration management, and software quality processes will be an added advantage.
* Ability to track delivery dependencies, manage risks, monitor action items, and support governance reporting for project stakeholders.
* Good knowledge of CI/CD, version control tools such as Git/SVN, and software delivery practices is desirable.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or any related stream.

title: Manager-Delivery Management
description:
**Job Description**
 Global Commercial Services (GCS) serves millions of business customers around the world, from mom\-and\-pop shops to Fortune 500 companies. We back businesses so they can do more business, with a mission to be the undisputed leader in financial and membership services \- responsibly driving double\-digit revenue growth. We do that by offering a diverse range of payment and cashflow tools, from a wide range of traditional card products, to working capital and supply chain financing, to new digital solutions that make it easy for our customers to manage a full range of their financial and payment needs.
   

  

 Manager, Delivery Management oversees the delivery of technology projects and coordinates with senior leadership, stakeholders, and other technical teams to drive successful project outcomes and implement best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Oversees the planning, development, and delivery of technology projects, ensuring they meet business requirements, timelines, and quality standards, and align with strategic goals
* Leads the facilitation of Program Increment (PI) Planning meetings with leadership, product management teams, delivery teams, and business partners
* Collaborates with stakeholders to define project goals, requirements, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical feasibility
* Leads solution design discussions that provide technical oversight and adheres to Enterprise Architecture standards on complex APIs and/or application integrations
* Orchestrates breakdown of work, sequencing, assignment of tasks, and scheduling multiple work streams
* Manages change control and escalation handling in project/s
* Proposes solutions to overcome delivery impediments; supports issues resolution through creative solutions
* Manages impediments, risks, dependencies, and resourcing needs across stakeholders and senior leadership
* May or may not manage and lead a team of Technology Delivery colleagues, enabling a culture of continuous learning, growth opportunities, and inclusivity for all individual colleagues and teams
* May or may not provide leadership, guidance, and coaching to Technology Delivery teams, supporting training and development of best practices
* Collaborates with senior leadership to hire top talent for the team, ensuring a high\-functioning and cohesive unit, implementing strategies for talent retention and professional development
* Collaborates and co\-creates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives
* Establishes integrated release plans that align dependencies and milestones across teams, trains, and external partners


**Qualifications**
**Education Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and practices
* Knowledge of Project Management
* Knowledge of Technology Delivery
* Knowledge of Agile management tools such as Jira, Rally, or similar platforms


**Work Experience**
* 8 – 12 Years of Experience in project management, delivery management, or a related job within the technology sector
* Experience in leading and mentoring technology delivery teams
* Experience in working in an Agile/Scrum environment
* Experience in application design, software development, and automated testing
* Experience in distributed (multi\-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience in Agile software development methodologies and practices such as Scrum/Kanban, iterations, user stories
* Experience in automation testing and documentation (i.e., automated, functional, and performance)
* Experience with Application Programming Interface (APIs), RESTful services, and middleware platforms
* Licenses and Certifications:
* Certification in SPC (SAFe Program Consultant), SA (SAFe Agilist), PMI\-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner), or PMP (Project Management Professional) is a plus


**About Us**

From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

title: Associate Project Delivery Leader

title: Change Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
 Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.
   

  

 Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in\-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.
   

  

**How do we add value?**
* Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
* Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
* The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
* Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.


 Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.
   

  

 We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real\-time data with our 40\-year\-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Change Delivery Manager is the central orchestrator of the Operations Automation Deployment Framework. This role ensures that all automation initiatives move seamlessly through the critical stages (Planning PO \- UAT → Process Documentation → Training → Go\-Live → Support → Impact Measurement), with clear accountability at each stage and synchronized delivery across Operations.
   

  

 This is a business\-facing role centred on planning, project management, delivery orchestration, change enablement, not technical development which is managed by the technology organisation. The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, technical teams, and operational leadership, ensuring that nothing falls between the cracks and that all deployment initiatives deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Framework Governance \& Stage\-Based Delivery
   

  

 Own and manage the 6\-stage deployment roadmap with clear timelines, dependencies, and stage gate criteria. Define and enforce gate review processes. Hold role leads accountable for stage deliverables: UAT sign\-off → Process Documentation complete → Training delivered → Go\-live readiness → Support SLA achieved → Impact measured. Make go/no\-go decisions with Steering Group. Escalate blockers and risks immediately to sponsor/leadership.
   

  

 Role Coordination \& Accountability
   

  

 Recruit and staff the 5 core roles (Ops UAT Lead, Process \& QMS Lead, Innovation Lead, SME Expert, Change Champion). Ensure role clarity through RACI matrix ownership. Manage role interdependencies so that outputs from one stage properly feed into the next. Conduct weekly 1\-on\-1 check\-ins with each role lead to track progress, identify blockers, and adjust workload. Act as the RACI translator when accountability is unclear.
   

  

 Steering Group Leadership \& Gate Governance
   

  

 Chair weekly Steering Group meetings (Operations Lead, Innovation Lead, Process \& QMS Lead, Change Champion, SME Expert, Finance rep). Facilitate status updates, gate reviews, risk escalation, and dependency management. Maintain Stage Gate Register tracking which gates have passed, which are pending, and which carry risk. Ensure decisions are documented and communicated. Escalate critical blockers to C\-level when necessary.
   

  

 Delivery Timeline \& Risk Management
   

  

 Develop and maintain the master deployment timeline from UAT kickoff through post\-launch impact review. Identify and manage dependencies between stages and roles; flag risks where delays in one stage will impact downstream stages. Track schedule vs. planned dates; communicate delays and recovery actions proactively. Maintain RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies); review and escalate weekly. Forecast go\-live and impact review dates based on gate outcomes.
   

  

 Change Communications \& Stakeholder Alignment
   

  

 Develop deployment communications plan covering awareness, training, go\-live messaging, and post\-launch updates. Partner with Change Champion to ensure local and centralized messaging align. Provide executive reporting and regular updates to sponsor, steering group, and broader stakeholders. Address resistance and concerns early; work with Change Champion to surface and resolve adoption blockers.
   

  

 Go\-Live Orchestration \& Support Readiness
   

  

 Create go\-live runbook: deployment sequence, cutover plan, rollback procedures, support escalation paths. Coordinate go\-live rehearsals (1–2 dry runs before live day). Act as on\-call Command Center lead during go\-live; own decision\-making on escalations and rollback. Ensure Support Team is staffed and ready. Oversee transition from Innovation Lead to operations support. Monitor support SLA post\-go\-live; escalate unresolved issues.
   

  

 Value Realization \& Impact Measurement
   

  

 Define success metrics with sponsor (time savings, cost reduction, quality improvements, adoption %, defect trends). Track KPIs at 1\-week, 1\-month, 3\-month, and 6\-month post\-go\-live checkpoints. Produce Impact Report (Stage 6 deliverable) demonstrating ROI, identifying process improvements, and capturing lessons learned. Ensure feedback loops: use impact data to inform next automation initiative.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Program/Project Management: 5\+ years managing complex, multi\-stage projects from initiation through closure. Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid methodologies. Proficiency with project management tools (JIRA, Monday.com, Azure DevOps, Asana). Strong understanding of gates, stage reviews, and governance frameworks.
* Change Management: 3\+ years in formal change management (ADKAR, PROSCI, or equivalent). Experience designing and executing change strategies. Proven ability in stakeholder engagement and resistance management. Ability to diagnose adoption blockers and design targeted interventions.
* Operations \& Process Optimization: Understanding of operational workflows, process optimization, and automation benefits. Ability to translate business requirements into technical/process specifications. Familiarity with metrics\-based performance management (KPIs, dashboards, reporting).
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication: Ability to influence across technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable facilitating difficult conversations and resolving conflicts. Executive\-ready presentations and reporting.
* Orchestration \& Coordination: Ability to manage multiple dependencies and moving pieces without direct authority. Strong organizational skills. High tolerance for ambiguity; quick decision\-making with incomplete information.
* Risk \& Issue Management: Proactive identification of risks and issues. Ability to assess impact and recommend mitigation. Strong escalation discipline. RAID log ownership.


**Desired Qualifications:**
* Background in operations, financial services, or manufacturing (industries with complex multi\-site rollouts).
* Experience with automation/RPA/workflow tools and their operational impact. PMP, PSM, or PRINCE2 certification. Lean/Six Sigma or continuous improvement background. Data\-driven mindset with comfort in dashboards, KPI tracking, and evidence\-based decision\-making.


**Why work at Stats Perform?**
**We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!**
 We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.
   

  

**We take care of our colleagues**
 We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.
   

  

**We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.**
 We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform**
 By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.
   

  

 With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

description:

title: Associate Manager, Product - Tech, Insight
description:
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge** 
 is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15\+ central and state governments.
   

  

 Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1\.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200\+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
   

  

**Founded** 
 with the support of 130\+ eminent philanthropists, 40\+ corporates, and 15\+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty\-free India, within our lifetime.
   

  

**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
 We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near\-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30\. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
   

  

**What are we solving for?**
 Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near\-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35\. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
   

  

 For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention \- reading glasses \- can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
   

  

 Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
   

  

 With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
   

  

 Many individuals aren’t aware that their near\-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
   

  

 Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community\-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
   

  

 Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia\-free using a community\-led model.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure \& AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production\-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third\-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams


**Who are we looking for in this role?**
* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour \- especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5\+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:
+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI\-first, fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)


**What’s in it for you?**
* Own your growth: An impact\-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L\&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people\-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000\+ households, 15\+ governments, 200\+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product\-based approach in an action\-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.


*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Software Test Engineer Lead
description:
**Description**
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Software Engineer Test Lead with strong hands\-on experience in both manual and automation testing. The ideal candidate will lead QA activities, define test strategy, improve automation coverage, validate non\-functional requirements, and ensure high\-quality product releases.
   

  

 This role requires strong experience with C\#, Selenium, BDD frameworks, performance testing, SQL Server, Azure DevOps/VSTS, and Agile/Scrum delivery. The candidate should bring an automation mindset while remaining strong in manual testing, exploratory testing, defect analysis, and release validation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end QA activities for assigned product areas, sprints, and releases.
* Analyze requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and client issues to define effective test coverage.
* Lead the group of 5 or more QA engineers.
* Create and review test plans, test cases, test data, traceability matrix, and test execution reports.
* Perform and guide manual testing across functional, regression, integration, exploratory, smoke, sanity, and end\-to\-end scenarios.
* Drive automation strategy, framework enhancement, reusable utilities, automation best practices, and regression coverage improvement.
* Create, maintain, and execute BDD\-based test scenarios aligned with business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Define and validate application stability benchmarks, quality gates, release readiness criteria, performance expectations, and NFRs.
* Perform API testing, backend validation, database validation, and performance testing as part of end\-to\-end quality assurance.
* Manage test execution, defect tracking, QA reporting, and release status using standard QA/test management tools.
* Analyze defects, identify root causes, work with developers through resolution/retesting, and mentor QA engineers on testing practices, automation, defect analysis, and quality standards.
* Communicate QA status, risks, blockers, defect trends, and release readiness while continuously improving QA processes, test coverage, automation effectiveness, and product quality.


**Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* 7–10 years of experience in software testing with a strong mix of manual, automation, API, performance, and release testing.
* Hands on experience in leading the team of 5 or more QA engineers.
* Strong hands\-on manual testing experience across functional, regression, integration, exploratory, smoke, sanity, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong hands\-on automation experience using C\# and Selenium.
* Experience with BDD frameworks and ability to write, maintain, and execute behavior\-driven test scenarios.
* Experience creating, enhancing, or maintaining automation frameworks and reusable testing utilities.
* Hands\-on experience with performance testing concepts and tools such as LoadNinja, JMeter, LoadRunner, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of NFRs including performance, scalability, reliability, availability, usability, security, and maintainability.
* Experience with API testing, backend validation, and SQL Server queries for data verification and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, defect lifecycle, release testing, and QA metrics.
* Experience using Azure DevOps/VSTS or similar tools for test management and defect tracking.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to guide QA engineers while remaining hands\-on in testing and quality delivery.


**Good to Have / Added Advantage**
* Exposure to security testing concepts and tools, including OWASP\-based testing and vulnerability checks.
* Working knowledge of additional automation tools or frameworks such as Python, Playwright, PyTest, keyword\-driven frameworks, or Robot Framework.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build or release workflows.
* Experience testing reconciliation, financial close, accounting, or enterprise SaaS applications.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar tools for test design, test data creation, automation productivity, and defect analysis.


**Cultural Fit**
* Strong ownership and accountability for product quality.
* Passionate about manual testing excellence and automation maturity.
* Detail\-oriented, analytical, proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working in a global Agile environment.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills and continuous improvement mindset.


*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

 The Global Digital Asset Operations Coordinator has a significant impact by ensuring 3M’s digital assets are managed consistently, efficiently, and in alignment with global business standards. By coordinating projects, connecting stakeholders across regions and functions, and supporting governance practices, this role helps improve asset quality, metadata accuracy, publishing readiness, and operational visibility. This enables faster content delivery, better reuse of approved assets, reduced duplication of work, stronger compliance with digital asset standards, and improved collaboration among marketing, product, creative, IT, and business teams. title: Senior Associate-Digital Product Ops
description:
**Job Description**
 The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high\-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company
   

  

**Responsibilities**

**Product Operations \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end product operating model by driving operational processes that improve product planning, release management, and execution.
* Coordinate product delivery activities across Product Managers, Engineering, Technology, and Operations teams to ensure timely and high\-quality releases.
* Aggregate, validate, and publish release notes to downstream systems and Application Support teams for every product release.

 Technical Product Manager
   

  

 Want to be a part of Asia Pacific \& Japan’s (APJ) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?
   

  

 AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose \- to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers \- the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
   

  

 Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
   

  

 Come join the A\-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
   

  

 A Snapshot
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on, technically strong product manager to help shape and deliver high\-impact digital products at AirTrunk.
   

  

 In this role, you will own the discovery, design, delivery, adoption and continuous improvement of technology\-enabled products that help our teams work faster, smarter and with greater operational discipline. Depending on business priorities, these products may include internal SaaS\-style applications, workflow platforms, data\-enabled products, decision support tools, integrations, automation solutions and AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 You will work closely with business teams, engineering, data, AI and technology stakeholders to turn complex operational needs into clear product strategies, pragmatic roadmaps and scalable solutions. You will be comfortable operating across the full product lifecycle, from identifying the right problem to solve, through to shaping user journeys, defining requirements, partnering with engineering, managing delivery, measuring value and iterating based on feedback.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who combines strong product management discipline with technical depth. You do not need to be an AI product specialist, but you should be fluent in how modern product teams can use AI to improve discovery, delivery, analysis, prototyping, documentation and decision\-making. You should also be able to identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation and data\-driven capabilities where they genuinely improve product outcomes.
   

  

 Your Day to Day
   

  

 Product Ownership \& Delivery
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of digital products and technology\-enabled capabilities, from discovery and problem definition through to delivery, adoption, measurement and iteration.
   

  

 Develop clear product visions, roadmaps, value cases and success metrics aligned to business priorities.
   

  

 Page \| 2
   

  

 Translate complex business needs into well\-structured product requirements, user stories, process flows, data needs and technical considerations.
   

  

 Make clear prioritisation decisions based on user value, business impact, feasibility, risk and delivery capacity.
   

  

 Bring structure and product discipline to ambiguous opportunities, helping teams move from ideas and requests to clearly defined problems, outcomes and delivery options.
   

  

 Technical Product Delivery
   

  

 Partner with engineering, data, AI, architecture and technology teams to design and deliver scalable products, platforms and technology\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 Work across user experience, workflow design, data models, APIs, integrations, reporting, security, governance and operational support requirements.
   

  

 Help shape SaaS\-style and platform\-based solutions that are reliable, usable, maintainable and designed for enterprise adoption.
   

  

 Collaborate with technology teams to define MVPs, delivery increments and long\-term product evolution.
   

  

 Ensure products are designed with appropriate attention to usability, performance, resilience, data quality, security and supportability.
   

  

 Balance speed, quality and scalability by making pragmatic trade\-offs between immediate business value and longer\-term product sustainability.
   

  

 AI, Automation \& Modern Product Practice
   

  

 Use AI and automation tools to improve the way product work is done, including discovery synthesis, research analysis, prototyping, documentation, backlog creation, testing support and stakeholder communication.
   

  

 Identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation or data\-driven decisioning into products and workflows where they create measurable value.
   

  

 Promote responsible, secure and pragmatic use of AI within product delivery and product experiences.
   

  

 Model modern ways of working by using AI thoughtfully to improve quality, speed, clarity and decision\-making across current initiatives.
   

  

 Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

 Partner with business domain experts to understand operating models, pain points, workflows, decisions and user needs.
   

  

 Communicate product vision, trade\-offs, delivery progress, risks and value outcomes clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Facilitate alignment across business, technology, data, AI, security and operations teams.
   

  

 Act as the bridge between business problems and technology solutions, ensuring delivery remains anchored to measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Influence without authority across complex stakeholder groups, bringing clarity to competing priorities and helping teams make informed product decisions.
   

  

 Product Excellence \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Use product analytics, telemetry, user feedback and operational data to evaluate product performance and identify improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Page \| 3
   

  

 Drive adoption and change management in partnership with business teams, ensuring products are embedded into real ways of working.
   

  

 Continuously improve product practices, templates, rituals and standards across AirTrunk’s product community.
   

  

 Stay informed on modern product management, enterprise SaaS, digital platforms, AI\-enabled product delivery and emerging technology trends.
   

  

 Create a strong feedback loop between users, business stakeholders and delivery teams to ensure products continue to evolve based on evidence, value and changing business needs.
   

  

**Requirements**
 5\+ years' experience in product management, technical product management, digital product delivery, enterprise technology, SaaS products, platform products, data products or related roles.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience owning products or technology\-enabled capabilities through the full lifecycle, including discovery, prioritisation, delivery, adoption, measurement and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Strong product management discipline, including problem discovery, user research, roadmap development, requirements definition, backlog management, Agile delivery, release planning and value measurement.
   

  

 Strong technical fluency across modern software delivery, APIs, integrations, data platforms, workflow systems, cloud environments and enterprise architecture concepts.
   

  

 Experience working closely with engineering, data, architecture or platform teams to deliver software products, enterprise applications, internal platforms or full\-stack digital solutions.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
   

  

 Strong prioritisation and decision\-making skills, with the ability to balance user value, business impact, technical complexity, delivery capacity, risk and long\-term product sustainability.
   

  

 Comfortable using AI and modern productivity tools to improve product workflows, accelerate analysis, support documentation, improve delivery quality and model contemporary ways of working.
   

  

 Understanding of security, privacy, data governance, operational risk and responsible AI considerations in enterprise technology environments.

title: Strategy and Operations FDE
description:
**About TrueFoundry** 




 Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure. A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
 



 That infrastructure layer is being built right now.
 



 We're TrueFoundry, and we're building it.
 



 The Problem We're Solving
 



 Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self\-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi\-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
 



 The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct\-tape together a few API calls and call it production\-ready.
 



 You need a control plane that handles:
 


* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self\-hosted models, custom tools, and agents



 AI Gateway is the control plane — five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
 



 We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Founder’s Office who will work closely with the founders and FDE leadership to drive strategic initiatives, customer engagements, and execution across the organization.
 



 This is a highly cross\-functional role spanning customers, engineering, product, and business strategy. You will work on some of TrueFoundry's most important and ambiguous problems and help turn strategic priorities into execution.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Work directly with the founders and FDE leadership on high\-priority strategic initiatives.
* Partner closely with FDE engineers on enterprise customer engagements, technical challenges, and deployments.
* Understand customer problems and translate them into actionable requirements for Product and Engineering.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and opportunities to improve TrueFoundry's product and platform.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives from problem definition to execution and measurable outcomes.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure customer priorities are addressed effectively.
* Build processes and operating mechanisms that help the FDE organization scale efficiently.
* Track critical initiatives, identify bottlenecks, and drive teams toward resolution.
* Prepare business reviews, analysis, and decision\-making material for founders and leadership.
* Support strategic customer conversations and help drive key enterprise initiatives.
* Take ownership of special projects that require speed, judgment, and cross\-functional execution.
* Act as a key bridge between the Founder’s Office, FDE, Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.



**What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, product, solutions engineering, business operations, engineering, or a similar high\-ownership role.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work comfortably with technical teams, enterprise customers, and senior leadership.
* Strong execution mindset with the ability to take ambiguous problems and drive them to completion.
* Ability to quickly understand technical products, customer requirements, and business context.
* High ownership, strong judgment, and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Willingness to roll up your sleeves and work across functions rather than operate within a narrow job scope.



**Good to Have** 



* Experience working with AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, developer platforms, or enterprise SaaS.
* Experience in a Founder’s Office, Chief of Staff, Consulting, Product, Solutions Engineering, or FDE environment.
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers.
* Technical background or strong technical aptitude.
* Experience in a high\-growth startup.



**Perks of Working at TrueFoundry** 



* Join a fast\-growing Series A, Bay Area\-based startup building cutting\-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

description:
Position : Project Coordinator – Digital Literacy (Urban)
   





 Location : Bangalore
   





 Reports to : State Head
   





 Tenure : 1 Year
   





 HelpAge India is a secular, not\-for\-profit organisation in India, registered under the Societies’ Registration Act of 1860\. Set up in 1978, the organisation works for
 *‘the cause and care of disadvantaged older persons to improve their quality of life’* 
 . It runs healthcare, agecare, livelihood, disaster response and awareness initiatives throughout the country \& advocates strongly for the elder cause. It became the first and only Indian organization to be honoured with the ‘UN Population Award 2020’ for its exemplary work in the field of ageing and population issues, and earlier in 2014, has been the recipient of
 *‘Vayoshreshtha Samman’* 
 by Government of India, as an institution working for senior citizens. We have been awarded highest CRISIL VO 1A grading for excellence in operations and high credibility. We have been recognized as a Great Place to Work.
   





**Role Overview**

 The Project Coordinator will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing the Digital \& Financial Empowerment Programme for senior citizens across the state. The position requires close engagement with senior citizen associations, community volunteers, community stakeholders, and project teams to ensure effective program delivery, achievement of targets, and timely reporting.
   






  





**Programme Implementation \& Coordination** 
  




* **Coordinate and oversee programme implementation across designated districts and** 
 urban locations.
* Develop and maintain a database of Senior Citizen Associations (SCAs), Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), clubs, elder groups, and urban slum communities.
* Ensure adherence to project timelines, guidelines, and quality standards.
* Monitor programme activities and provide regular updates to the State Program Manager, State Head, and Programme Lead.



**Training \& Capacity Building** 
  




* Organize and facilitate monthly digital, financial, and legal literacy workshops for senior citizens.
* Conduct awareness sessions on digital safety, cyber fraud prevention, online services, financial inclusion, and legal rights.
* Train and mentor youth volunteers to support programme implementation.
* Build local resource networks to strengthen outreach and programme impact.



**Monitoring, Reporting \& Documentation** 
  




* Ensure achievement of monthly and quarterly programme targets.
* Collect, verify, and maintain programme data for monitoring and evaluation.
* Prepare and submit progress reports, MIS reports, success stories, photographs, videos, and case studies.
* Track participant feedback and recommend improvements to enhance programme effectiveness.



**Stakeholder Engagement** 
  




* Build and maintain strong relationships with SCAs, RWAs, elder groups, banks, financial institutions, legal authorities, and community stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder consultations, programme reviews, and planning meetings.
* Represent the programme at local events, networking forums, and observances such as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day (WEAAD) and International Day of Older Persons (IDOP).



**Administrative Support** 
  




* Coordinate logistics for workshops, training programmes, and outreach activities.
* Maintain records of programme activities, attendance, and volunteer engagement.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and project requirements.


 Requirements
   

  


**Qualifications \& Experience** 
  






  




* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Sociology, Development Studies, Education, Management, or a related field.


* 1 to 3 years of experience in programme coordination, community development, outreach, training, or related social sector projects.
* Experience working with senior citizens, digital literacy, financial inclusion, or community\-based programmes will be preferred.



**Skills \& Competencies** 
  




* Programme planning and project management
* Training and facilitation skills
* Stakeholder engagement and partnership building
* Monitoring, evaluation, and reporting
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* MIS and data management
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Volunteer and team management
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and digital tools

* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).

* Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

****Preferred****

**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

 Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a senior Scrum Master with exposure to Business Analysis to drive Marketing Tech portfolio products deliverables within the Plasma\-Derived Therapies (PDT) business unit. In this role, you will drive Agile best practices, facilitate sprint execution, create and manage JIRA boards, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality data solutions. We are seeking an experienced and talented individual that can help Takeda enhance productivity and efficiency when performing distributed delivery model.
   

  

 In addition, you will mentor and coach team members in Agile delivery, building a team culture of growth and development. This role will work closely with the Product team located in US and Delivery team located in India. This role will align to the Transformation enablement chapter of Takeda ICC.
   

  

 This position will report to a PDT Delivery lead for strategic direction and day\-to\-day management.
   

  

**How you will contribute:**
 Agile Facilitation \& Team Enablement
   

  

* Strong leadership with a people\-first, empowering mindset
* Manage and facilitate Agile ceremonies, including PI planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews/Demos, Sprint Retrospectives, Backlog refinement, Sprint Priority Review and Project Review
* Coach and ensure the team follows Agile best practices, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing culture.

* Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize Product backlog for PI commitment and Sprint Backlog for Sprint planning to align on business and technical objectives.
* Facilitate Backlog refinement with Product Owner and Team on stories acceptance criteria
* Play key role in facilitating PI Planning sessions, breakout sessions, track dependencies, risks, engages team in discussion, assess PI objectives, identifies team capacity constraints, ensures the team tracks towards the committed PI objectives, regular status updates to leadership.
* Able to manage scrum of scrum, cross team coordination. Guide team through ROAM (Resolve, Own, Accept, Mitigate).
* Continuous improvement action plans from retrospectives


 Capacity \& Priority Planning
   

  

* Manage PI planning, sprint capacity planning, ensuring appropriate allocation of tasks while preventing overloading.
* Support estimation, sprint commitments, velocity tracking, and capacity planning
* Lead team discussions on high\-priority upcoming demand and new project work.


 Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication
   

  

* Act as a bridge between Business, Product and Delivery team to ensure alignment.
* Own and prepare data driven reports, presenting Agile team progress to leadership.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies and coordinate with external stakeholders.
* Maintain transparency with effective communication on sprint outcomes, blockers, and dependencies.
* Assist Program Lead, Delivery lead, Product Owner and Product engineers with regular reporting on project updates and highlights
* Encourage collaboration between Global DD\&T , engineering , QA, architecture, and business teams.
* Facilitate release planning, production deployments, and go\-live readiness.


 Jira \& Confluence Administration

* Track progress using Agile metrics (burndown, burnup, velocity, cycle time).
* Ability to identify opportunities in existing JIRA/Confluence setup and collaborate with platform team for needed enhancements

* Own access control and permissions for required tools, ensuring team members have the required access.
* Standardize JIRA reporting across products within In\-Center domain


 Proactive Risk Management
   

  

* Promote early issue detection through Agile ceremonies (e.g., retrospectives, risk assessment workshops)
* Facilitate Risk identification, escalation, and resolution.
* Proactive problem\-solving and escalation handling


**Product \& Business Analysis Responsibilities (Preferred)**
* Translate business needs into clear and actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria for data\-focused teams.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and business leaders to define and refine the product roadmap.
* Ensure data governance, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded within the team’s Agile processes.


 Driving Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Foster a culture of innovation within Agile teams by encouraging experimentation, process improvements, and adoption of new technologies.
* Identify opportunities to enhance Agile workflows, automate manual processes, and optimize data\-driven decision\-making.


**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications :**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration or a related field (MBA degree preferred)
* 8\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master in application development and delivery, with strong SDLC expertise and demonstrated cross\-functional collaboration with Engineering, UX, QA, and DevOps teams.

title: Technical Programme Manager
description:
**About the role**
 The Online Technology team have led the way in delivering outcomes which are driving the transformation of the Tesco Technology platform: We have significantly grown the number of customers who rely on us to deliver their shopping to their home or convenient location. We saw substantial increases in volumes and customers through the pandemic which tested and proved the scalability of the platform. These increases saw use regularly exceed over 1\.3m orders a week though the retail platform.Since then we have scaled and changed the landscape of what we sell online by launching multiple propositions such as Whoosh, Marketplace and recently F\&F. Over the next few years we will be significantly growing Whoosh, continuously pushing the Marketplace proposition and scaling our Clothing mission to become the one stop shop. 
   

  

 Sitting in the Online team does not mean you are bound by the restrictions of Clothing, Marketplace, Groceries or Whoosh. We often are interfacing with the multiple business units and missions a customer comes to the website and app to fulfil, you will be part of the Online integrated programme, product and engineering space. The Online programme team unlock real world value for our customers across multiple shopping missions.
   

  

**You will be responsible for**
 Technical Programme Managers (TPMs) deliver complex, cross\-functional technology programmes that support colleagues and help serve our customers better. They work collaboratively, influence Product, Engineering and business colleagues and lead the programme to deliver value quickly and often.
   

 Whilst specific responsibilities will be dependent upon the changing needs of the Tesco business, the following provides an overview of the role’s key responsibilities and measures:
   

 • Deliver programmes with business and/or technical risks• Optimise or use a standard programme delivery methodology for delivering programme goals (e.g. agile, waterfall, iterative) • Bring together, coordinate and energise virtual technology teams to deliver programme goals• Create and track a plan to deliver the programme goals, including the technical implementation plan• Understand trade\-offs and resulting impacts; make impacts visible to Product, Infrastructure or Engineering for the right decision to be made • Managing dependencies, delivery timelines and implementations plans, using my knowledge of technical architecture• Appreciating and responding to delivery challenges, using my knowledge of engineering best practices and/or infrastructure implementations• Understand technology concepts, grasp new ones quickly and appreciate their implications on delivery• Effectively manage major incidents, ensuring stakeholders are updated with the right information to drive the correct decisions• Build positive relationships with suppliers \& external stakeholders to deliver software or professional services• Coach peers and other roles, teaching where required, on methodologies and programme management tools• This role will best suit an individual who enjoys working as part of a team, is well organised, pragmatic and a lateral thinker with an inquisitive mind who is motivated to make change for the better and, most importantly, puts our customers first.
   

  

**You will need**
 You’ll need to have:
   

 • A proven accomplished record of delivering technology and/or infrastructure; having done so across multiple teams in multiple geographies• Experience of building credible relationships and influencing management and leadership teams• Excellent verbal and written communication skills – you must be able to articulate complex concepts to a diverse audience.• The ability to influence without authority.Personal
   

 • Flexibility, ability to plan and organise, responsiveness, creativity, self\-starter • Demonstrate resilience during change and continue delivery
   

  

**Whats in it for you?**
  

 At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
   

  
   

 As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market\- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
   

  
   

 Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars \- Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
   

  
   

 Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles \-simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
   

  
   

**Salary** 
 \- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
   

  
   

**Leave \& Time\-off** 
 \- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
   

  
   

**Making Retirement Tension\-FreeSalary** 
 \- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
   

  
   

**Health is Wealth** 
 \- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in\-laws. 
   

  
   

**Mental Wellbeing** 
 \- We offer mental health support through self\-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face\-to\-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
   

  
   

**Financial Wellbeing** 
 \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
   

  
   

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** 
 \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.  
   

  
   

**Physical Wellbeing** 
 \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
   

  

**About Us**
 At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
   

  
   

  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
   

  
   

  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

title: Product Management and Software Engineering Intern
description:
Sapiensu is looking for a product management and engineering intern.
 



  





 Sapiensu reads the public record on a company or an individual and returns findings a deal team can act on, and still defend six months later in front of an investment committee, a lender or a regulator.
 



  





 Learn more here: www.sapiensu.com
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 One person doing two jobs.
 



  





 You will write and ship code in the product, and you will work on the product itself: sitting in customer conversations, reading back what was said, and helping decide what gets built next.
 



  





 This is not a shadowing role. The product is built and in use by external testers.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WOULD BE WORKING ON** 




  





 \- Customer development against a waitlist who signed up before there was a product to show them, and helping work out which of them we should be building for.
 



 \- Sitting in user conversations and turning what you hear into decisions about what we build next.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




  





 \- Evidence that you have built something and finished it. A side project, a tool, a repository. It does not have to be polished and it does not have to be in our domain.
 



 \- Genuine curiosity about why people behave as they do, and the willingness to change your mind when a user contradicts you.
 



 \- Comfort in a very small team with no structured on boarding and no training programme.
 



  





 You do not need prior experience in finance, law or diligence.
 



  





 You do need to be interested in why a finding has to survive being challenged six months after it is written.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* Comfortable with React and TypeScript; working knowledge of at least one of Python, Rust, or Go
* Prior exposure to backend, data, or AI/LLM APIs
* Quick learner, comfortable with ambiguity, and curious about new industries



  





**TERMS** 




  





 Stipend, commensurate to experience and qualifications. Three months, full\-time, in person in Bengaluru.
 



  





 If you perform well, there is a real possibility of a full\-time role at the end of the internship. We would rather state it that way than promise something we cannot guarantee in advance.
 



  





**TO APPLY** 




  





 Email your resume to parita@sapiensu.com with something you have built, and a paragraph on why you want to work on this (do not use AI, write it yourself).

title: QA Manager
description:
We are seeking a QA Manager with 8\-12 years of experience in software testing and quality assurance, including experience leading QA teams in fast\-paced product environments.
 



 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on quality leader with strong expertise in both manual and automation testing, a proven track record of driving high\-velocity daily releases, and the ability to build and develop high\-performing QA teams. This individual will be responsible for the quality strategy for Indee's products while actively contributing to release planning, testing initiatives, process improvements, automation efforts, and production quality outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own and continuously evolve Indee's QA strategy across manual, automation, regression, exploratory, API, performance, and release testing.
* Lead QA efforts throughout the software development lifecycle, including test planning, test execution, defect management, risk assessment, release validation, and release sign\-offs.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled testing approaches and continuously evaluate opportunities to improve testing efficiency, quality, and coverage.
* Drive release quality by establishing strong validation processes, improving regression coverage, and minimizing production defects.
* Define, track, and report on key quality metrics, including production defect leakage, release readiness, automation coverage, defect trends, and test effectiveness.
* Conduct root cause analysis for production issues and implement preventive actions to improve product quality and release stability.
* Drive automation initiatives across the QA function, improving automation coverage, framework reliability, execution efficiency, and long\-term maintainability.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and improve testing effectiveness through API\-based and UI\-based automation approaches.
* Mentor and develop QA engineers across manual and automation testing disciplines, supporting skill development, career growth, and technical excellence.
* Enable manual QA engineers to contribute to automation efforts through coaching, structured ownership, and ongoing support.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through testing, release, and production support.
* Support timely investigation, validation, and resolution of customer\-reported issues, production incidents, and QA\-related escalations.
* Improve release planning, workload allocation, and team capacity management to support multiple concurrent projects and business priorities.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the QA team, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, capacity planning, and succession planning.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high\-performing team culture that promotes ownership, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.



  





**Requirement** 




**Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field; master's degree preferred.
 



  





**Experience:** 



* 8\-12 years of QA experience in product companies. Candidates whose experience is exclusively in IT services environments may not be the best fit for this role.
* 4\+ years of experience managing/leading QA teams.



  





**Must\-Haves:** 



* Strong people leadership and planning skills
* Ability to schedule work with tight timelines without overworking the team.
* Strong hands\-on experience in QA of web and mobile applications.
* Experience in test automation using Selenium with Python, leveraging BDD frameworks.
* Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of test strategy, test planning, regression testing, defect management, and release validation processes.
* Experience leading QA for production releases and driving release sign\-off decisions.
* Experience defining, tracking, and analyzing quality metrics and release health indicators.
* Strong understanding of root cause analysis and defect prevention methodologies.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong background in CI/CD pipelines
* Strong capabilities in git/github
* Strong experience in JIRA, issue tracking, JIRA customization, and reporting.
* Experience with Appium or mobile automation frameworks.



  





**Good\-to\-Haves:** 



* Exposure to performance testing
* Understanding of ISO\-27001 processes and frameworks
* Understanding of SOC\-2 compliance and application / QA\-specific needs.
* Exposure to security and penetration testing.
