title: R&D Senior Software Test Engineer - IDC
description:
**The opportunity**
 At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future by enabling stronger, smarter, and more resilient power systems. Quality is central to how we deliver trusted digital solutions for customers worldwide. We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Test Engineer to join our Grid Automation team and help shape the quality of mission\-critical software used in modern energy systems.
   

  

 In this senior role, you will take ownership of complex testing activities, influence quality strategy, and collaborate with global engineering teams working on advanced Grid Automation technologies. You will contribute to scalable test practices, automation maturity, CI/CD readiness, and continuous improvement while growing your expertise in a global organization committed to innovation, sustainability, and technical excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Lead the definition of test objectives, test strategy, test scenarios, and execution plans for complex product and release activities.
* Identify required test environments, equipment, test data, tools, and other provisions needed for effective testing. Partner with functional leaders to ensure readiness for test start and completion in line with program schedules, including maintenance and minor releases. Report test progress, quality risks, and release readiness to the Test Manager and key stakeholders, escalating proactively when progress toward a stable, releasable product is at risk. Support and strengthen CI/CD practices across products, with a focus on expanding automation of key tests.
* Ensure defects are documented clearly, accurately, and with the technical detail needed to support efficient investigation and resolution.
* Work closely with developers, product owners, and engineering stakeholders to analyze, resolve, and verify product issues across the software lifecycle.
* Continuously strengthen testing expertise, automation skills, and domain knowledge in Grid Automation and power system software.
* Act as a senior contributor in a cross\-functional team by sharing knowledge, supporting collaboration, and helping the team deliver high\-quality outcomes aligned with shared objectives.


**Your background**
* At least 8 years of professional experience in quality assurance, software testing, or test engineering, preferably in complex software product environments.
* Strong knowledge of QA best practices, testing methodologies, quality processes, and risk\-based testing approaches.
* Hands\-on experience with low\-level testing, including API and integration testing, in microservices\-based architectures.
* Good understanding of microservices architecture and related testing areas, including message queues, Kubernetes, Docker, and distributed system behavior.
* A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to influence quality discussions across technical and cross\-functional teams.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.
* Knowledge of Python, Robot Framework, Azure DevOps, and PostgreSQL is a strong advantage.
* Experience with Jira, Helm, test automation frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines is considered an advantage.


**What We Offer**
* Flexible working time
* Health care and wellness allowance
* Excellent career development opportunities within Hitachi Energy in Bangalore and across our global engineering organization.
* Access to an employee benefit portal with thousands of discounts and perks.
* The opportunity to work on meaningful technologies that support a more sustainable, flexible, and secure energy future.


**More About Us**
 Join Hitachi Energy and be part of a global team where your expertise in quality, automation, and software testing can make a real impact on the future of energy. If this opportunity sounds like the right next step for you, we encourage you to apply today. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so do not delay.

title: Application Testing
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Senior QA Tester, you will play a crucial role in our e\-commerce migration project. Your expertise in retail and e\-commerce, coupled with your experience in Azure, will be instrumental in ensuring the successful migration of our retail customer's platform. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a leading technology company and make a significant impact on a high\-profile project.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop, create and execute comprehensive test plans and strategies for the e\-commerce migration.
* Collaborate closely with development and business teams to understand requirements and ensure alignment.
* Perform in\-depth testing of the retail customer's platform, identifying and reporting issues.
* Execute regression, integration, system, smoke, and UAT testing.
* Implement automated testing frameworks and tools to enhance efficiency and coverage.
* Conduct performance and load testing to ensure the platform's scalability and stability.
* Create detailed test cases and test scripts, covering various scenarios and edge cases.
* Review and provide feedback on the development team's code and designs.
* Lead and manage the testing team, ensuring efficient and effective test execution.
* Document and communicate test results, providing clear and actionable insights.
* Stay updated with the latest testing methodologies and best practices in the retail and e\-commerce domain.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in QA testing, with a focus on retail and e\-commerce projects.
* Proven experience in leading and managing testing teams, preferably in an e\-commerce context.
* Strong knowledge of Azure and its testing capabilities, including Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Exposure to microservices architecture and event\-driven systems.
* Excellent understanding of software development lifecycle and agile methodologies.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional team.
* Proficiency in test case design and test script creation.
* A proactive and innovative approach to testing, with a passion for continuous improvement.

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

 The role resides within the Data Management Change Team, reporting to the Data Change Lead in Bangalore. title: Scrum Master
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated Scrum Master with strong Agile delivery experience to lead cross\-functional teams in delivering enterprise\-scale digital transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coaching Agile teams, managing stakeholder expectations, and driving continuous improvement in complex enterprise environments.
 



 Experience working on cloud transformation, application modernization, or large\-scale Agile programs within Banking or Financial Services will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Sprint Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum principles, Agile best practices, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a collaborative, transparent, and psychologically safe team environment.
* Remove impediments and proactively resolve delivery risks and blockers.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Track sprint progress, team velocity, burndown, and delivery metrics using Azure DevOps Boards.
* Communicate sprint progress, risks, and dependencies effectively with business stakeholders.
* Drive Agile maturity across teams by introducing best practices and facilitating process improvements.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of business objectives.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and encourage strong collaboration across distributed teams.
* Support release planning, dependency management, and PI Planning activities where applicable.
* Promote customer\-centric delivery while ensuring high\-quality product outcomes.



  





**Required Skills** 



* 8–10 years of overall IT experience with at least 5 years as a Scrum Master.
* Strong understanding of Agile frameworks including Scrum and Kanban.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Azure DevOps Boards** 
 for sprint planning, backlog management, dashboards, and reporting.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies for multiple Scrum teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience tracking Agile metrics including velocity, burndown charts, sprint health, and team performance.
* Proven ability to remove impediments and improve team productivity.
* Experience working with distributed Agile teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and facilitation skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working on cloud migration, digital transformation, or application modernization programs.
* Exposure to Banking, Financial Services, or Capital Markets domain.
* Experience working in SAFe Agile environments.
* Knowledge of Agile estimation techniques and release planning.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Power BI, or similar Agile reporting tools.



  





**Certifications** 



* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM)
* SAFe Scrum Master or other SAFe certification is an added advantage

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Engineering Manager** 




*Accelerate Performance.* 




  





**About CAI Software** 




 CAI Software builds purpose\-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI\-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long\-term performance partner.
 



 With 6,200\+ active customers worldwide and a market\-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45\+ years of industry expertise with modern AI\-driven execution \- helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15\+ industries and 10\+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact.
 



  





**CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve** 




  





 CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing \- aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company.
 



  





  





**CAI India** 




 CAI India is a strategic investment in the company’s future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support\-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery for the EDI Products engineering team, ensuring commitments made to Product Management and Product Owners are met on time and with quality.
* Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to translate roadmap items, epics, and backlog priorities into a well\-sequenced, achievable engineering plan.
* Champion AI\-led development practices across the team — embedding AI\-assisted coding, testing, and documentation tools into day\-to\-day engineering workflows to improve velocity and code quality.
* Manage the team’s use of Azure DevOps (ADO) and ADO\-Git for work item tracking, sprint/iteration planning, branching strategy, pull requests, and release management.
* Collaborate with Product Management in Aha! to keep roadmap, initiatives, and feature\-level plans aligned with engineering capacity and delivery status.
* Ensure engineering standards, designs, and decisions are documented and kept current in Confluence for team and cross\-functional visibility.
* Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, backlog refinement) and drive continuous improvement in team process and delivery predictability.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers; conduct performance reviews, set growth goals, and support career development within the team.
* Manage team capacity, staffing needs, and hiring in partnership with the VP of Engineering.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and quality issues early, and drive mitigation plans in collaboration with engineering and product stakeholders.
* Report delivery status, risks, and metrics to the VP of Engineering and other stakeholders on a regular cadence.
* Support and enforce secure, compliant engineering practices appropriate to EDI and manufacturing data integration workloads.



  





**AI\-Led Development** 




 This role requires active leadership in adopting AI\-assisted engineering practices as a core part of how the team builds and ships software, including:
 


* Guiding engineers in the effective use of AI coding assistants for implementation, code review, refactoring, and test generation.
* Establishing team norms and guardrails for responsible, secure use of AI tools with proprietary and customer\-related code and data.
* Measuring and reporting the impact of AI\-led development on delivery speed and quality, and continuously refining the approach.
* Staying current on AI\-assisted software development practices and evaluating new tools/approaches for team adoption.



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Azure DevOps (ADO) and ADO\-Git
* Aha! (Product roadmap and planning alignment)
* Confluence (Engineering documentation and knowledge sharing)
* AI\-assisted development tooling as adopted by the organization



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years in an engineering management or team lead role.
* Proven experience managing software delivery using Azure DevOps (ADO) work items, boards, and ADO\-Git repositories/pull requests.
* Experience partnering directly with Product Managers and/or Product Owners to plan and prioritize engineering work.
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and a demonstrated interest in applying them to improve team output.
* Strong people\-leadership skills: coaching, performance management, and building a high\-trust, high\-accountability engineering culture.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical topics for non\-technical stakeholders.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with EDI, B2B integration, or manufacturing/supply\-chain software domains.
* Experience modernizing legacy systems or leading teams through technology migrations.
* Background in .NET, middleware/integration platforms, or ISAM/relational data systems.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Predictable, high\-quality delivery against roadmap commitments made with Product Management.
* Measurable adoption and impact of AI\-led development practices within the team.
* A well\-documented, well\-governed engineering process in ADO, Aha!, and Confluence that stakeholders trust.
* An engaged, growing engineering team with clear goals and strong retention.



  





  





**Why Join CAI** 




 At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6,200\+ customers across 15\+ industries and active investment in AI\-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like — and we are building the team to lead that work.
 



 Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers — and how we work:
 


* Built to Fit \- Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
* Built to Expedite \- Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays.
* Built to Deliver \- AI turns action and insights into measurable performance.
* Built to Scale \- Sustains and scales performance without disruption.

title: UAT Engineer
description:
Job Purpose
   

 • Enable end\-to\-end UAT and SIT delivery by coordinating with Product Owners, Journey Leads, QA, technology teams, and business users to ensure testing milestones, execution, and go\-live readiness are met.
   

 • Drive test governance and execution oversight through preparation and management of test cases, defect tracking, triage calls, Azure DevOps reporting, and daily test status communication.
   

 • Ensure effective stakeholder coordination and issue resolution by organizing UAT sessions, tracking actions, risks, and dependencies, and working closely with squads to resolve integration and testing challenges.
   

 • Provide clear visibility and control through reporting and documentation by maintaining centralized documentation, dashboards, metrics, and regular progress reports to support informed decision\-making and timely releases.
   

 Key Result Areas
   

 • Supporting Product Owner and Journey Lead to coordinate testing
   

 • Prepare test cases and capture test results in Excel and Azure DevOps
   

 • Organize UAT Sessions with Business users / Relationship Managers
   

 • Document and track action items, feedback, issues and risks
   

 • Work with PO to identify and define key milestones of the UAT
   

 • Track tasks for project and follow up with internal teams in terms of tracking
   

 • Monitor project progress and handle any issues that arise with support from Tech Project Manager
   

 • Maintains comprehensive documentation, plans and reports in centralized location
   

 • Support QA / Tech Test Manager to ensure coordination between Squads \& technology during SIT and UAT respectively
   

 • Work closely with SIT members to resolve the Integration issues and challenge SIT teams on defects
   

 • Working along Tech QA Manager to track test management activities in Azure DevOps
   

 • Ensure release adherence during go\-live
   

 • Coordinate action closures and work with program teams to resolve the roadblocks of testing
   

 • Weekly/monthly testing dashboard / metrics and reporting
   

 • Run defect triage calls on a daily basis with the squad members
   

 • Publish the test status report on a daily basis
   

  

 Knowledge, Skills and Experience
   

 • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a closely related technical discipline.
   

 • 4\-7 years of relevant experience
   

 • Familiarity with Azure DevOps
   

 • Hands\-on experience on Azure dashboards
   

 • Experience of testing in Agile methodologies
   

 • Experience in test estimation techniques is story points or T\-shirt sizing
   

 • Experience in impact analysis and planning Regression testing

description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Product Management \- Manager, you will lead the charge in developing innovative software solutions that drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver software products that revolutionize industries and provide exceptional user experiences. This role involves designing, coding, and testing applications that meet the evolving needs of clients.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring your team to deliver quality results. You will be responsible for coaching and leveraging team members' unique strengths to meet client expectations. With your growing business acumen, you will play a crucial role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values meaningfully. Embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will also address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, while upholding professional and technical standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Managing and mentoring teams to enhance their skills and deliver quality software products
* Designing, coding, and testing applications using programming languages such as Java, Python, and C\#.NET
* Overseeing the application of software development methodologies and lifecycle management

* Leading teams through ambiguity with composure and sound judgment
* Excelling in client management and delivering impactful messages

* Utilizing AI fluency and AI\-human collaboration in project management
* Excelling in software engineering with a focus on microservices
* Leveraging analytical thinking for business process improvement
* Managing client relationships with effective communication and feedback
* Embracing change and innovation in software development methodologies

title: Manager - Application Transformation Delivery
description:
**Date Posted:**
 2026\-09\-18
   

  

**Country:**
 India
   

  

**Location:**
 IN\-KA\-BENGALURU\-NORTHGATE \~ Sy No 2/2 Venkatala Village \~ SY NO 2/2 VENKATALA VILLAGE, Yelahanka Hobli
   

  

**Position Role Type:**
 Hybrid
   

  

 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
   

  

 This role provides on‑the‑ground leadership for the Application Modernization \& Transformation (ATE) team in India. The Lead oversees a growing team of analysts \& developers and ensure high‑quality delivery across modernization initiatives. This position maintains alignment with global digital transformation priorities, strengthens collaboration across ES Applications, and drives consistent DT practices throughout the portfolio.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities:
   

  

 Manage India‑based resources supporting ATE priorities and ensure strong execution across modernization and transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Coordinate work assignments, prioritize activities, and support future team expansion as program needs evolve.
   

  

 Guide the team in delivering clear insights into portfolio health, modernization opportunities, performance trends, and application lifecycle considerations.
   

  

 Solid technical understanding of cloud technologies, digital transformation practices, and emerging AI capabilities to support modernization initiatives.
   

  

 Partner closely with the RTX India ES team to identify future transformation opportunities, while promoting ATE capabilities to other ES‑aligned teams in India to expand engagement and drive broader adoption.
   

  

 Promote continuous improvement, best practices, and standardization across the team to ensure consistent, scalable, and high‑quality delivery.
   

  

 Required Qualifications:
   

  

 Strong understanding of cloud technologies, modern application architectures, digital transformation concepts, and key modernization practices such as refactoring, re‑platforming, and process digitization.
   

  

 Familiarity with emerging AI capabilities and the ability to interpret complex application portfolios to guide teams on health, lifecycle, and modernization opportunities.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and grow delivery teams, manage workload allocation, and coordinate multiple workstreams in fast‑moving environments.
   

  

 Ability to drive standardization, best practices, and continuous improvement while collaborating effectively with global and cross‑functional teams.
   

  

 Experience working with business and technology leaders to align delivery with strategic priorities, promote modernization solutions, and support adoption of consistent transformation practices across portfolios.
   

  

 Required Education:
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 5\+ years of experience in application modernization, digital transformation, or enterprise technology delivery.
   

  

 5\+ years of experience leading technical or cross‑functional teams, preferably in a global delivery model.
   

  

 Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:
   

  

 Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
   

  

 Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.
   

  

 Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a degree of onsite presence associated with this role.
   

  

 Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.
   

  

 Requires advanced to expert knowledge of work area typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience.
   

  

 May have broad knowledge of project management. Requires substantial knowledge of RTX projects, programs or systems in order to provide enhancements within job area.
   

  

 Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years experience
   

  

 Engineering/Other Technical Positions: Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience unless prohibited by local laws/regulations.

 The Senior Release Management role is responsible for end\-to\-end planning, coordination, governance, readiness management, and execution of technology platform and business use cases releases.

 The individual is expected to independently lead complex release cycles, identify risks proactively, drive remediation actions, and continuously improve release processes through standardization and automation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own Falcon Major Release and Monthly Minor Release governance.
* Maintain Falcon Release Calendar and Moratorium Schedule.
* Track all governance artifacts and approvals through release lifecycle.
* Manage release readiness across Platform Features and Use Case Onboarding releases.
* Coordinate release\-related ARB, ISRMP, AROW, GenAI Review, and MRM activities.
* Drive continuous improvement of Falcon Tollgate and Release Management processes.
* Provide executive release reporting to Falcon leadership.

title: Senior Software Technologist I - Testing
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Senior Software Technologist I \- Testing
   

  

**Job Description**
 Philips is a global leader in health technology, dedicated to improving lives through meaningful innovation. This role sits within
 **Hospital Patient Monitoring (HPM),** 
 which provides advanced monitoring solutions for acute care settings. From bedside and transport monitors to centralized systems, HPM helps clinicians identify at\-risk patients and intervene quickly.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **System Verification Lead** 
 who combines
 **strong system\-level thinking with hands\-on verification expertise and technical leadership** 
 . The successful candidate will understand complex system integration points, translate product and system risks into effective verification strategies, and lead a verification team through planning and execution across multiple projects and releases. This is a
 **Technical Lead** 
 role with no direct people\-management responsibility, but it requires
 **strong ownership, influence, coaching, and cross\-functional coordination** 
 .
   

  

**Your Role**
 This role provides
 **technical leadership for system verification across multiple projects and releases** 
 , driving verification strategy, execution, risk management, and test automation to
 **ensure high\-quality, compliant product delivery** 
 . The position coordinates verification planning, mentors team members, resolves technical challenges, oversees verification documentation and Design History File deliverables, and collaborates closely with cross\-functional stakeholders including engineering, quality, security, and regulatory teams. The role also focuses on
 **improving verification efficiency through automation, AI\-driven practices, continuous improvement, and proactive communication of quality, risk, and release readiness metrics.**
* Automation Expertise:
+ Strong experience in Java automation using Selenium.
+ Hands\-on experience with BDD frameworks (development and maintenance).
+ Proficiency in web service automation testing (REST/SOAP).

* Test Design \& Strategy:
+ Identifies potential system\-level risks through system analysis and designs test scenarios to mitigate these risks, contributing to early defect detection and preventing critical issues from reaching later stages of the development process.
+ Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability by adjusting test strategies based on system complexity and evolving requirements by creating new test cases, modifying existing ones, or prioritizing tests to ensure focus on critical functionalities.
+ Contributes to increased efficiency by supporting the creation of test automation frameworks for repetitive tasks by identifying suitable automation tools, developing reusable test scripts, and collaborating with colleagues to integrate automation into the overall testing process.
+ Ability to define and execute test cases for functional, performance, reliability, and scalability testing.
+ Skilled in log analysis and identifying problem areas to accelerate defect resolution.

* Technical Knowledge:
+ Knowledge of CI/CD, continuous testing, automation integration, source control, and pipeline practices.
+ Good understanding of IT infrastructure, virtualization, networking, cloud technologies, system integration environments, and laboratory setup.
+ Experience with log analysis and tools used for requirements, test, and defect management, such as JIRA or ALM.

* Reporting \& Documentation:
+ Ability to generate test reports compliant with quality management systems.
+ Strong understanding of defect management processes and tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM).

* Additional Skills:
+ Experience with AWS, JMeter, Postgres, AngularJS is a plus.
+ Familiarity with SAFE Agile methodology.
+ Exposure to cybersecurity verification, system hardening, authentication and authorization, network security, or secure deployment configurations.


**You're The Right Fit If**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology
* 10\-13 years of experience in software or system verification, including test strategy, system integration testing, manual testing, and test automation.
* Strong Systems thinking, Execution leadership, technical influence, Quality ownership, Continuous improvement mindset and Adaptability is required to be successful in the role.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, planning, and problem\-solving skills.


**How We Work Together**
 We believe that we are better together than apart. This is an office\-based role, which means working in person at least 3 days per week.
   

  

**About Philips**
 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
   

  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.


 If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is Seeking a Software Engineering Manager.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of individual contributor engineer roles with low to moderate complexity and less experienced managers who are responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non\-functional requirements with each release
* Engage with architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture to enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example, cloud readiness, application modernization and data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross\-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to make decisions and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement culture
* Build engineering skills side\-by\-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop, and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with low to moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate and consult with the Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for technology engineering including career development and performance management for engineers and managers on the team
* Hire, mentor and guide talent development of direct reports to build the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for the supported product areas/products


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2\+ years of Leadership experience


**Desired Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience with 2\+ years leading engineering teams.
* Experience building and operating enterprise\-scale platforms or developer productivity solutions.
* Strong understanding of:
+ Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
+ Developer tooling ecosystems
+ Cloud\-native architectures
+ CI/CD and DevOps practices
+ Platform engineering
+ API and microservices architectures
+ Security and compliance controls

* Proven experience leading globally distributed teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive large\-scale engineering transformation initiatives.
* Experience with Internal Developer Platforms (IDP).
* Experience managing IDE ecosystems, developer workstations, or development environments.
* Experience building enterprise frameworks or platform services.
* Knowledge of OpenShift, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and platform engineering principles.
* Experience with AI\-assisted software engineering tools and agentic development workflows.
* Experience driving developer experience (DevEx) initiatives at enterprise scale.
* Experience managing engineering portfolios, budgets, and strategic roadmaps


**Job Expectations:**
**Engineering Leadership**
* Lead and develop high\-performing engineering teams responsible for developer tools, IDE platforms, engineering frameworks, reusable utilities, configuration services, and automation platforms.
* Establish a strong engineering culture focused on innovation, quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor engineers, technical leads, and engineering managers while fostering career development and technical growth.
* Drive organizational strategy, workforce planning, and execution against business priorities.


**Developer Tools \& Environments**
* Own the lifecycle management of enterprise development tools including onboarding, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, rationalization, and retirement.
* Lead development of self\-service capabilities for tool provisioning, developer onboarding, access management, and environment setup.
* Drive modernization of developer workstations, cloud\-based development environments, and IDE ecosystems.
* Partner with security, risk, and compliance organizations to ensure approved tool usage and governance adherence.
* Improve developer productivity through automation, simplification, and AI\-powered developer experiences.


**Frameworks \& Utilities**
* Lead development and adoption of enterprise frameworks for Java, .NET, UI, Python, and future technology stacks.
* Drive design and delivery of reusable engineering utilities, platform services, and accelerators used across application teams.
* Own enterprise configuration services, common runtime capabilities, shared libraries, and platform standards.
* Establish framework governance, lifecycle management, upgrade automation, and adoption strategies.
* Ensure frameworks incorporate security, reliability, observability, performance, and compliance requirements by design.


**Platform Engineering \& Architecture**
* Define technical strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards.
* Partner with enterprise architecture and product management teams to create long\-term technology roadmaps.
* Drive cloud\-native, API\-first, and AI\-first engineering practices.
* Scale platform services to support thousands of engineers and enterprise applications.
* Lead architecture reviews and technology decisions that balance innovation, risk, and operational excellence.


**AI \& Automation**
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to automate software delivery, tool governance, framework upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and developer onboarding.
* Champion agentic engineering and self\-service platform experiences.
* Measure and improve developer productivity through automation and AI\-driven insights.


**Operational Excellence**
* Define and track OKRs, KPIs, SLAs, and operational health metrics.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability, availability, and security.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives.
* Manage technology debt, platform modernization, and continuous improvement programs.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Security, Risk, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and application development teams.
* Influence senior leadership and drive alignment across multiple organizations.
* Present strategy, roadmaps, business cases, and operational outcomes to executive leadership.


**Posting End Date:**
 29 Sep 2026
   

  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.


**We Value Equal Opportunity**
 Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit's risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.
   

  

 Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

title: Technical Lead
description:
This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will write
 **production code every day** 
 , and you will lead by building the hardest parts yourself.
 



 It is

 . There is no team to administer, no appraisal cycle, no delivery meetings in place of engineering. If you have moved away from daily coding, this role will not suit you.

* React
* React Native
* Python
* Salesforce
* Cloud\-native, across all major clouds
* An agentic layer running through all of it
* Whatever else the client needs

 Production code every week, on the parts that matter most. Design, write, review, ship.

 LLM\-driven features running in production for clients. Agents, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation, and the cost and latency behind each choice.

 Design and code reviews for two or three engineers working alongside you.

 Scope, estimate, sequence and commitment date. When a date is at risk you raise it before it moves.

 Requirements, trade\-offs, and what is possible by when.

* 6–8 years in software engineering, hands\-on throughout
* Python, with production depth

* Delivery ownership: you have carried a date and answered for it

**Preferred:** 



* Both startup and large\-organisation experience
* Daily use of AI engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead

* Salesforce
* Client\-facing experience, in India or abroad

 Screening call, technical discussion, delivery and leadership conversation, offer. We aim to close within two weeks of first contact.

description:

 Company: Bridgestone
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 Bridgestone Cortex APIs are a global Marketing capability that provides trusted, scalable access
   

  

 to core business data across Bridgestone. Supporting teams in Europe, North America, and
   

  

 Latin America, Cortex APIs enable access to product, location, inventory, fitment, pricing, and
   

  

 services data that powers digital experiences, commercial operations, and customer\-focused
   

  

 solutions.
   

  

 As Bridgestone evolves its data strategy for the age of AI, Cortex APIs will play a critical role in
   

  

 making high\-quality, connected data accessible across the enterprise. This team contributes to
   

  

 strategically important initiatives that strengthen data\-driven decision\-making, accelerate
   

  

 innovation, and support Bridgestone's ambition to become the world's number\-one tire
   

  

 manufacturer.
   

  

 Bridgestone is seeking an experienced, proactive Scrum Master to support Agile delivery for
   

  

 Data and MuleSoft integration teams. This role will enable teams to deliver high\-quality
   

  

 integration and data solutions with improved predictability, flow, and sustainable velocity.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be more than a facilitator of Scrum ceremonies. They will actively
   

  

 identify delivery risks, remove or escalate impediments, manage cross\-team dependencies,
   

  

 coach Agile ways of working, and help the team continuously improve its ability to deliver value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Scrum Leadership and Agile Coaching
   

  

* Coach one or more cross\-functional teams in Scrum and Agile principles,


 practices, and behaviors.
   

  

* Facilitate effective Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint


 Review, and Retrospective sessions.
   

  

* Help teams establish clear Sprint Goals, realistic commitments, and actionable


 Definition of Ready and Definition of Done practices.
   

  

* Foster a culture of transparency, ownership, collaboration, continuous learning,


 and accountability.
   

  

* Coach Product Owners and team members on effective backlog management,


 prioritization, estimation, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

* Assess Agile maturity and introduce practical improvements tailored to the


 team's needs.
   

  

 Proactive Impediment and Dependency Management
   

  

* Proactively identify blockers, delivery risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies


 before they impact sprint commitments.
   

  

* Own the process for documenting, tracking, escalating, and driving resolution of


 impediments.
   

  

* Partner with engineering leaders, platform teams, product owners, architects,


 and external stakeholders to resolve issues related to environments, access,
   

  

 integration dependencies, release readiness, and resource constraints.
   

  

* Challenge inefficient ways of working and facilitate solutions that reduce


 recurring blockers.
   

  

* Support the team in managing dependencies across Data, MuleSoft,


 application, infrastructure, security, QA, and DevOps teams.
   

  

 Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Use Agile delivery metrics to identify improvement opportunities and promote


 sustainable team performance.
   

  

* Monitor and help improve measures such as sprint\-goal achievement, carryover


 work, cycle time, throughput, blocker aging, defect trends, and delivery
   

  

 predictability.
   

  

* Facilitate retrospectives that result in clear improvement actions, with


 ownership and follow\-through.
   

  

* Help teams reduce handoffs, waiting time, rework, and unnecessary process


 overhead.
   

  

* Support adoption of engineering practices that enable reliable delivery, including


 automation, CI/CD, DevOps collaboration, and quality practices.
   

  

 Stakeholder Alignment and Communication
   

  

* Serve as an effective facilitator between delivery teams, Product Owners,


 business stakeholders, architects, and leadership.
   

  

* Communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement


 opportunities clearly and transparently.
   

  

* Ensure stakeholders understand team capacity, priorities, dependencies, and


 realistic delivery timelines.
   

  

* Facilitate planning and alignment across multiple teams where integration


 dependencies exist.
   

  

 Data and MuleSoft Delivery Support
   

  

* Develop sufficient understanding of Data and MuleSoft integration delivery to


 anticipate common delivery constraints and support effective team planning.
   

  

* Support teams delivering API\-led integrations, data pipelines, data services, and


 related platform capabilities.
   

  

* Work with technical leads and architects to ensure technical dependencies,


 environment readiness, test data, security reviews, and release activities are
   

  

 visible and managed.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience working in Agile delivery environments, including 3\+ years


 as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or similar role.
   

  

* Demonstrated experience proactively removing impediments and improving


 team delivery flow.
   

  

* Experience supporting software, data, API, integration, or platform engineering


 teams.
   

  

* Strong practical knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery principles.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams toward greater


 autonomy and maturity.
   

  

* Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or


 equivalent.
   

  

* Strong ability to manage cross\-team dependencies, risks, and stakeholder


 expectations.
   

  

* Excellent facilitation, communication, conflict\-resolution, and problem\-solving


 skills.
   

  

* Ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with technical


 and business stakeholders.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting MuleSoft, API integration, enterprise data, cloud, or


 middleware delivery teams.
   

  

* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and


 environment management practices.
   

  

* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum


 Master, or equivalent certification.
   

  

* Experience working in scaled Agile environments, including SAFe or multi\-team


 delivery models.
   

  

* Familiarity with Agile flow metrics and evidence\-based approaches to


 continuous improvement.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* The team consistently meets Sprint Goals and delivers commitments with

* Impediments and dependencies are identified early, visibly tracked, and


 resolved quickly.
   

  

* Carryover work, avoidable delays, and recurring blockers are reduced.
* Team members increasingly own their delivery process and continuousimprovement


 actions.
   

  

* Stakeholders have clear visibility into priorities, risks, dependencies, and


 delivery progress.
   

  

* The team improves sustainable velocity while maintaining quality and avoiding

title: Scrum Master Lead Analyst - Cigna Healthcare
description:
bout Cigna
   

  

 Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.
   

  

 Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.
   

  

 We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.
   

  

 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.
   

  

 This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.
   

  

 The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Team Coaching and Agile Enablement
   

  

* Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.
* Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self\-management.
* Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.
* Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.


 Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.
* Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.
* Facilitate evidence\-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow\-through on agreed outcomes.
* Encourage Built\-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day\-to\-day team working practices.


 Facilitation and Cadence Events
   

  

* Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.

* Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.
* Support ART\-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect \& Adapt, as applicable.


 ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments
   

  

* Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.
* Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.
* Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.

* Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.
* Team ceremonies and cadence events are purposeful, outcome\-focused, and continuously improved.
* Metrics and qualitative insights are used to improve flow, predictability, quality, and stakeholder transparency.
* Teams operate at a sustainable pace while maintaining alignment with ART priorities and International Health business outcomes.
* Continuous improvement becomes embedded in the team culture.

* At least 6 years of proven experience as a Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach role.
* Experience facilitating team development and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Lean\-Agile principles, Scrum practices, Kanban practices, and team\-level Agile delivery.
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and understanding of its principles and practices.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage priorities in a changing environment and support teams working under delivery deadlines.
* Ability to interact with Subject matter experts, Product Owners, Agile Product Managers, and stakeholders in a matrix structure.

**Desired Qualifications / Skills / Experience**

* Experience supporting product, platform, operational, or service\-based delivery teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change and Agile transformation initiatives.

* Define, document, and continuously improve the team's delivery cadence — sprint/iteration length, ceremony schedule (planning, refinement, review, retro), and reporting rhythm.
* Ensure the cadence is followed: ceremonies happen on schedule, with the right people, producing real decisions.
* Adapt cadence to the needs of different workstreams (e.g., a fast\-moving feature team vs. a compliance\-heavy workstream) without fragmenting the organisation into inconsistent processes.


**Stage Gate Ownership**
* Own the criteria for moving work between stages (e.g., Discovery → Ready for Build → In Progress → Review → Release) and enforce them consistently.
* Act as the checkpoint before work advances: confirm acceptance criteria are met, dependencies are cleared, risk/compliance sign\-offs are in hand, and Definition of Done is completed.
* Act when something is not ready and explain exactly what is missing and what is needed to pass the gate.
* Track and report exceptions/waivers when a gate is bypassed and ensure it is a deliberate decision.


**Delivery Planning**
* Build delivery plans grounded in real data: backlog sizing (story points/estimates), team velocity history, known dependencies, and risk.
* Convert scope and velocity into realistic timelines and communicate them as ranges with clear assumptions and confidence levels.
* Re\-forecast the plan on a regular cadence (e.g., every sprint) as scope, velocity, or risk changes, and proactively flag slippage.
* Maintain visibility tools (burnup/burndown, roadmap views, RAID logs) that let stakeholders self\-serve status.


**Cross\-Team Coordination \& Reporting**
* Be the primary point of contact for delivery status to leadership and stakeholders — translating team\-level detail into a clear picture of progress, risk, and trade\-offs.
* Identify and actively manage cross\-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts before they hit the critical path.
* Facilitate trade\-off conversations (scope vs. time vs. quality) with data.


**Process Ownership \& Continuous Improvement**
* Own the delivery process documentation (workflow stages, gate criteria, estimation method, ceremony structure) and keep it current, e.g. in Confluence.
* Run retrospectives that produce real process changes.
* Balance rigor with pragmatism — add process where it removes risk or ambiguity and remove process if not needed.


**Are you the one?**
* 8\+ years in a Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager role, ideally spanning multiple teams or workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience running Agile/Scrum (or Kanban/hybrid) delivery cadences end\-to\-end — not just attending ceremonies but designing and improving them.
* Hands\-on experience with story\-point estimation, velocity tracking, and forecasting delivery timelines from that data.
* Proven ability to hold a line on process/quality gates under deadline pressure, with the communication skill to do so without becoming a bottleneck or being seen as purely a blocker.
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting status, risk, and trade\-offs to senior leadership.
* Fluency with delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) and building reporting views (burnup/burndown, roadmaps, dashboards) that reduce manual status\-chasing.
* Hands\-on exposure to tools such as Postman and Datadog, with an interest in leveraging AI to improve delivery and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience delivering technology transformation initiatives, including system migrations, process transitions, or Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup and transition projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn ambiguous, fast\-moving work into a clear plan and a clear narrative.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in \[industry — e.g., fintech, trading platforms, regulated environments], particularly where compliance/risk sign\-off is part of the stage\-gate process.
* Certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMP (useful signal, not a substitute for hands\-on experience).
* Experience introducing or maturing a delivery process in an organization that didn't previously have one.

This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, people management, and delivery ownership, with the ability to guide architecture decisions while enabling teams to execute at scale. We thrive on culture of excellence our managers need to be hands\-on ; he/she will be the “Owner who can dive deep when required”.
   

  

 Reporting to the Group Manager, Technology Development, this role has the ownership on developing product(s) within the
 **Data Delivery team** 
 . The role will be involved with developing customer facing cloud hosted data as service products. This role necessitates meetings and require heavy collaboration within and across many teams. Our business model is hybrid, working from our Bangalore campus.

* Experience leading teams through Agile delivery and SDLC best practices.
* Ability to balance technical depth with people leadership and stakeholder management.

title: Product Operations Associate
description:
**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




**Replication launches \& platform setup** 



* Own end to end setup of new program launches across our messaging and IVR stack such as RapidPro, Turn, Exotel, Motor Admin and our internal Orchestrator.
* Validate and consolidate requirements from medical, film and translation teams before setup; manage template approvals and campaign creation, including code based configuration.
* Set up project specific journey logic (e.g., conditional acknowledgments, response handling) based on program requirements.
* Ensure every launch is delivered on time, thoroughly tested and fully functional before going live.



**IVR \& onboarding** 



* Build complete IVR journeys in Exotel such as onboarding flows, campaign journeys and user friendly navigation.
* Set up QR and IVR based onboarding, including QR configuration, Motor Admin flows, and Turn journeys, ensuring users are routed to the right campaigns.



**Data management** 



* Track incoming program data, maintain data trackers, monitor ingestion and identify and flag data errors on the dashboards.



**Platform quality \& troubleshooting** 



* Independently investigate and resolve technical issues across platforms where needed (e.g., language mapping, user profile updates, template approval scripts).
* Support platform transitions and migrations (e.g., moving flows, campaigns and media between messaging platforms).



**Documentation \& research tooling** 



* Write and maintain PRDs, launch runbooks, dashboard requirements, and other product documentation.
* Build survey flows in SurveyCTO for research and training projects, working with research teams on implementation and refinement, including IRB approval processes where required.



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in product management, program operations or technical implementation, ideally in digital health, social impact or messaging platforms.
* Comfort working hands on with no code/low code platforms (e.g., RapidPro, Turn, Exotel, SurveyCTO)
* Strong execution and coordination skills, able to run multiple concurrent launches with cross functional teams and hit deadlines without dropping quality.
* Clear written communication, can turn messy requirements into PRDs, runbooks, and documentation others actually use.
* A user first, detail oriented mindset: you test everything before launch and care about the experience of caregivers on the other end.



**Good to have** 



* Experience with IVR systems, audio content management or multilingual content operations.
* Familiarity with public health programs (MCH, TB, NCD) or working with government health systems.
* Experience with Figma

 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
   

  

 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
   

  

 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

* Bachelor/master’s degree in computer science or a closely related discipline, or an equivalent combination of formal education and experience.

* Hands on experience in HP QC, UNIX, AIX, MQ, Tidal/Autosys, Shell scripting, Jira, ServiceNow.

* Excellent communication skills and flexible and adaptable to new environments. Ability to quickly learn new systems, products, and businesses; Proactive and result oriented.

Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 Cohesity has a broad portfolio of cloud products including Data Management as a
   

  

 Service launched in 2020\. The products have web\-scale architecture and have the

They run in the data center and on multiple public clouds to address the data management needs of the customer wherever the customer's data might be. We are looking for an engineering leader for this core team, who would be solving some of the most exciting problems that will empower and challenge them.We seek to hire a Manager to lead our DataPath Engineering team. We are building massively distributed systems at web\-scale. Would be leading teams that work on a wide range of exciting and difficult problems and crafting and building massively parallel and distributed systems and architecture. Expert and innovative leaders who are up for the challenge of leading, innovating, mentoring, and working towards outcomes. We look for exceptional minds who love to solve complex problems and deal with critical challenges.
   

  

**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:**
* As an engineering leader, you will encourage, lead, and develop a team of outstanding software engineers across geo's that are redefining how enterprise customers manage their data.
* This role requires an energetic, creative, and driven individual with excellent communication, organization, and technical skills to partner with various organizations.
* Contribute to our data platform, which serves as a foundational platform for various on\-prem and aaS products at Cohesity.
* Responsible for the product end to end from working on product requirements with internal teams, to build, test and deploy for on\-prem as well as cloud, BaaS/DMaaS support.
* Mentor, lead and grow leaders in the team.
* Work closely with various stakeholders within Cohesity like product management, program management, sales, QA, and support teams to deliver high\-quality products and drive the product vision and roadmap.


**WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
* BS/MS/Ph.D. in Computer Science
* 6\+ years of people management experience in software development
* 12\+ years Experience in agile/scrum methodologies and knowledge of Storage domain or filesystem experience is a plus.
* Understand market dynamics to drive product direction and execution for the team.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support decision making.

title: Engineer III, Software Test
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

**Job Description**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.
   

  

 As a Software Developer, you will actively engage in comprehending software requirements thoroughly, ensuring end\-to\-end understanding, and delivering high quality code to fulfill these requirements. Your focus extends to optimizing system performance while prioritizing the long\-term maintainability of the codebase.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Perform scenario\-based manual testing of software applications to identify defects and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Analyze requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, edge, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Apply strong software testing techniques Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements.
* Conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand system requirements, identify requirement gaps, and validate software functionality.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Analyze test results, identify issues, and report defects in a clear and timely manner.
* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues, verify fixes, and ensure the integrity of the software.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with Python, where applicable, to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency.
* Execute and maintain automated test scripts as part of the overall testing process.
* Perform mobile device testing across applicable devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and configurations, where required.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospective meetings to provide input on testing activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.


**Minimum Requirements Or Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in software testing, verification, and validation.
* Strong proficiency in scenario\-based manual testing methodologies and techniques.
* Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience in test design techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Strong ability to derive comprehensive test scenarios from requirements, business workflows, and user behavior, including positive, negative, boundary, edge, and exception scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Experience in functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with Playwright automation using Python is an added advantage.
* Experience with Python and pytest is an added advantage.
* Experience in mobile device testing is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage workload efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies.
* Exposure to ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 standards for medical device development.
* ISTQB or similar certification is a plus.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 




  
 




**Job summary** 






 The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading a single engineering team to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions. This role focuses on day‑to‑day technical leadership, people management, and delivery execution within a defined product or platform area. The Engineering Manager works closely with Product, Architecture, and Operations to ensure the team delivers high‑quality outcomes aligned to roadmap and business goals.
 




  
 




**What you will do** 




* Technical Leadership 
 
	+ Lead technical execution for a specific product, service, or platform area.
	+ Ensure designs and implementations follow established architecture, security, and reliability standards.
	+ Promote best practices in coding, code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, and performance tuning.
	+ Partner with senior engineers and architects to plan and implement refactoring, modernization, and tech‑debt reduction.
* People \& Team Management
 
	+ Manage, coach, and develop a team of software engineers and senior engineers.
	+ Set clear goals and performance expectations; provide regular feedback and run effective1:1s.
	+ Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
	+ Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development to build a strong, diverse team.
* Delivery \& Execution
 
	+ Collaborate with Product Management to refine scope, priorities, and release timelines for the team.
	+ Own sprint planning, execution, and delivery for the team’s backlog.
	+ Ensure high quality through testing, code reviews, and adherence to SDLC and compliance standards.
	+ Identify risks and blockers early and drive resolution through coordination with partner teams.
* Operational Excellence
 
	+ Monitor and improve the health of the services owned by the team (reliability, latency, errors, cost).
	+ Participate in incident management, on‑call rotations, and RCAs; ensure follow‑through on action items.
	+ Drive incremental improvements in stability, automation, and operational efficiency for the team's services.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration
 
	+ Work closely with Product, Architecture, SRE/DevOps, Security, and QA to ensure alignment from design to release.
	+ Represent the team in project discussions, status updates, and stakeholder reviews.
	+ Translate product and business requirements into clear, actionable work for the team.



  
 




**What you will have** 




* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2–4 years in a people‑leading role.
* Hands‑on experience building and operating services on modern cloud platforms(AWS/GCP/Azure) and frameworks (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, or similar).
* Strong understanding of agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Proven ability to lead a team to deliver high‑quality software on time.



  
 




**Nice to have** 




* Experience working with distributed systems, APIs, and microservices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure/observability tooling.
* Experience collaborating with or leading cross‑geo or remote teams.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, or regulated SaaS environments.
* Interest or exposure to AI/ML or data‑driven product development.

description:

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges.
