Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

 DIGIS Tribes develop and maintain applications for Business Lines Avionics Global Services AGS, inside Thales GBU AVS.
   

  

 AVS business lines provides, all around the world, customer support and maintenance of avionics Thales equipment.
   

  

 The applications are built on top and outside SAP ERP. Their main business goals are to facilitate users’ day\-to\-day works (logisticians, repair technicians, marketing, sales, …) and improve overall industrial performance.
   

  

 Such applications need to be connected in real time to SAP ERP, through OData web services, to read, update or delete data (SAP objects). We also have multiple reports and dashboards executed from SAP as wel.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to join our agile delivery team. The Scrum Master will be responsible for facilitating scrum ceremonies, coaching teams on agile best practices, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Review, Retrospective) effectively and efficiently.

* Remove impediments and blockers that hinder team progress.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging feedback, team collaboration, and learning.
* Track and report key agile metrics (e.g., velocity, burn\-down charts) to stakeholders.
* Support cross\-team collaboration and coordination in a scaled agile environment.
* Assist teams in delivering high\-quality software incrementally and iteratively.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote a positive and productive team dynamic.
* Engage with stakeholders at various levels to ensure transparency and alignment.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 7 years of experience working as a Scrum Master or in an agile team environment.
* Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent agile certifications preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to remove blockers and resolve conflicts.
* Experience working with distributed and cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills, capable of engaging and influencing at all organizational levels


**Knowledge/ Skills**
* Experience in software development lifecycle (SDLC) and understanding of technical environments.
* Knowledge of scaled agile frameworks (SAFe, LeSS) and experience in large enterprise agile transformations.
* Ability to drive organizational change and agile adoption beyond the immediate team.


**Personal Attributes**
* Autonomous, curious, rigorous, with excellent analytical and summarizing skills.
* Good collaboration and communication skills
* You have a sense of service; you are comfortable communicating and you are diplomatic
* You have a sense of confidentiality, integrity and ethics


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.

* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition

 Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.
   

  

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.** 




**Why you’ll love this role** 



 You will own quality across services that shape the customer experience during and after their order on StockX. Your responsibilities span the entire order lifecycle: from trade execution and delivery date calculations to managing cancellations, returns, and order page updates. You will also oversee customer support chat functionality, buyer\-seller communications, real\-time order history, and offer tracking. Furthermore, you will ensure the reliability of RBAC\-enabled internal APIs and CRM integrations. Your testing will guarantee that customers have fast, accurate, and reliable tools to manage their orders at scale.
   

 You will work across a rich set of systems: an internal agent portal, GraphQL APIs, event\-driven Kafka pipelines, OpenSearch\-powered order and customer search, the bid\-ask\-decorator service that surfaces market and offers/order history data to customers, the estimated\-delivery\-date service that powers delivery predictions across pre\- and post\-purchase flows, and a real\-time chat platform that enables buyer\-seller and agent communication.Our technical stack includes Amazon Web Services, GraphQL, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, React, CircleCI, Kubernetes, Harness, Terraform, LaunchDarkly, OpenSearch, Kafka, SQS, Redis, Postgres, and Datadog. You will test across all of it.
   

 Our engineers and SDETs are empowered to own quality decisions, not just execute test cases. You will be expected to identify gaps, propose solutions, and present your work in team and org\-level forums.
 
**What you’ll do** 



* Collaborate with engineers and product managers to deliver high\-quality products
* Perform functional, regression, and smoke testing on new and existing products
* Review functional and technical documentation to define requirements and create clear, well\-structured test cases and plans, ensuring they align with business needs and best practices.
* Execute manual test cases and report test results by performing comprehensive testing: functional regression, end\-to\-end, database, web services, etc as desired
* Drive software testing best practices, including performance, load, and security testing

**Benefits**
 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Success depends on aligning a complex set of stakeholders, from UX writers, designers, product, and engineering to localization, experimentation, legal, and senior leadership.
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities And Duties**
 As a
 **Software Engineering Manager** 
 you are responsible for managing a team of engineers and working closely with product and tech stakeholders across the track and area to ensure timely and quality delivery of the roadmap.
   

  

 Important aspects of the job include:
   

  

* Inspire and develop individuals by helping create personal development plans, leveraging learning resources, and offering stretch opportunities for growth. Manage performance effectively by setting and reviewing clear objectives and KPIs, providing timely feedback, and collaborating closely with HR counterparts when needed.
* Ensure delivery through ownership by being proactive, collaborating with peers and stakeholders, tracking roadmap progress, and resolving or escalating blockers.
* Manage team stakeholders by clearly and regularly reporting progress and blockers to ensure transparency and alignment. Support recruitment and planning by participating in headcount planning and involving your team in hiring processes.
* Coach and mentor colleagues across levels by sharing your experience, knowledge, and approaches to work to improve overall performance.

Reduce operational risk by applying state\-of\-the\-art tools and practices, maintaining clear documentation (e.g. runbooks, OpDocs), and improving business continuity and the bus factor.
* Improve system reliability by addressing live production issues within SLA, contributing to root cause analysis, and logging and learning from incidents via postmortems.
* Build high\-quality software by applying relevant development languages, using standard libraries and design patterns, and following testing strategies that ensure security, integrity, and quality.
* Guide architectural decisions by advising on technical solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements, and aligning improvements with the wider architectural landscape.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing improvements in processes, systems, and structures, and by applying critical thinking to evaluate and develop ideas.


**Role Qualifications And Requirements**
**Must\-Haves:**
* 8\+ years of experience in building enterprise software products. Previous experience as a developer will be preferred
* 1\+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager (must be a dedicated management role, not a temporary caretaking assignment).
* Ability to read and understand code and apply simple design patterns to refactor code and ensure quality standard by applying testing strategies
* Maintain data security, integrity and quality by following company standards, best practices and relevant legislation.
* Ability to evaluate possible architecture solutions by taking into account the cost, business requirements, technology requirements and emerging technologies.
* Ability to describe the implications for changing an existing system or adding a new system to a specific area, by having a broad, high\-level understanding of the infrastructure and architecture of our systems.
* Ability to help grow the business and/or accelerate software development by applying engineering techniques (e.g. prototyping, spiking and vendor evaluation) and Bookings technical standards.

*If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre\-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre\-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.*

 As a Release
 **:** 
 Manager within the Digital Data \& Cloud Organization (DDCO), you will lead the planning, coordination, and governance of software releases across multiple product teams and applications. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring releases are prioritized, compliant, and delivered successfully, while minimizing operational risk and business disruption.
   

  

 You will work closely with Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, Product Owners, Engineering Leads, QA teams, and Change Advisory Boards (CAB) to manage release schedules, resolve cross\-team dependencies, secure required approvals, and maintain deployment readiness. You will establish and enforce release governance standards, oversee change management processes, maintain release checklists, and provide leadership visibility into release risks, delays, and deployment outcomes.
   

  

 Collaborating with business stakeholders and global leadership, you will help drive operational excellence through predictable, well\-governed release execution while fostering continuous improvement across release and change management practices.

 Lead for strategic direction and day\-to\-day management.
   

  

 How you will contribute
   

  

* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of releases across multiple product teams and applications.

* Partner with Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Engineering Leads, and QA teams to identify and resolve release dependencies, conflicts, and risks.

* Coordinate with Change Advisory Board (CAB) and Change Management teams to secure required approvals and ensure adherence to organizational policies and procedures.

* Drive continuous improvement of release and change management processes to improve release predictability, efficiency, and operational stability.
* Accountable for closure of continuous improvements identified from MIM \& Problems.

* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams including Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Engineering Leads, QA teams, Infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to identify, manage, and resolve release conflicts, deployment risks, and scheduling challenges across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to make data\-driven decisions in high\-pressure release environments.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills, with the ability to effectively communicate release status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices and experience working in regulated and compliance\-driven environments is highly desirable.

title: Manager, SW System & Solution Dev Engineer
description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
   

  

**Meet The Team**
 We are looking for a motivated and experienced Software Development Lead to spearhead the establishment and growth of our new R\&D Software design center in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. This role is crucial in setting up our software development and test operations, seeking out the best talent to join in our mission, and fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and collaboration.
   

  

 In this role, you will provide strategic leadership and oversight, guiding the direction of our software product development and test automation initiatives. You will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and timely delivery of high\-quality solutions.
   

  

 This position offers a unique opportunity to lead and shape the future of our R\&D reference arch and platform software efforts in a fast\-paced and collaborative environment. You will play a crucial role in the creation of new products and features, driving forward our technological advancements and market competitiveness. The portfolio you will be delivering includes mobile apps (iOS and Android), cloud\-based data platforms, web applications, software test frameworks, automation, and test scripts.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* Lead, develop, and mentor a software engineering team delivering mobile and cloud software solutions supporting Dexcom products and services.
* Establish and communicate team priorities and execution plans aligned with product and organizational objectives.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing, Systems Engineering, and other stakeholders to define requirements, plan development activities, and ensure successful product delivery.
* Build and maintain a high\-performing engineering team focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and execution across assigned software initiatives.
* Ensure software development activities comply with applicable quality system requirements, medical device regulations, cybersecurity standards, and company policies.
* Drive software development best practices across mobile and cloud applications, including iOS and Android development, cloud services, Agile methodologies, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development practices, and performance monitoring.
* Provide technical guidance and contribute to software architecture and design decisions across mobile and cloud systems to ensure scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and product quality.
* Manage team staffing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, employee development, and resource planning activities.
* Use key performance indicators (KPIs), engineering metrics, and operational data to monitor team effectiveness, delivery performance, and product quality and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across the organization to manage interfaces and dependencies, share knowledge, improve development practices, and support successful end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Identify and manage technical, schedule, quality, security, and execution risks, escalating significant issues and tradeoffs when appropriate.
* Partner with Quality, V\&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering functions to ensure software solutions meet functional, performance, reliability, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit activities, inspections, and regulatory submissions as required.
* Foster strong cross\-functional relationships and advocate for engineering quality, technical excellence, effective execution, and continuous improvement.


**What Makes You Successful**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8\+ years of software development experience, including experience delivering complex software products.
* 3\+ years of people management experience leading software engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading, developing, and mentoring a software engineering team.
* Strong experience with mobile and/or cloud application development, including iOS, Android, cloud services, or other connected software platforms.
* Experience delivering software products through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through development, verification, release, and maintenance.
* Experience managing engineering priorities, schedules, dependencies, risks, resources, and delivery commitments.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, software development methodologies, automated testing, and software quality practices.
* Ability to provide technical guidance and effectively evaluate software architecture, engineering decisions, technical risks, and tradeoffs.
* Understanding of distributed and connected software systems, including interactions and dependencies between mobile applications, cloud services, APIs, and other system components.
* Proven ability to collaborate with and influence cross\-functional stakeholders across Product, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, V\&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering organizations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Experience building and developing high\-performing engineering teams.
* Ability to balance technical quality, product requirements, regulatory requirements, resources, and delivery commitments.


**What You’ll Get**
* A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community.
* A full and comprehensive benefits program.
* Growth opportunities on a global scale.
* Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
* An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

* 7\+ years of years of successful leadership experience in relevant industry.

**The role**
 As a
 **Scrum Master \- Salesforce Marketing Cloud** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **6\+ YEARS** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are:**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)


****Responsibilities.****
 Facilitates Agile delivery for the SFMC development squad, ensuring the Agile rituals, transparency and continuous improvement principles required by the RFP are consistently applied. Works closely with the delivery manager, the SFMC Technical Lead and business stakeholders to keep the Marketing Cloud backlog healthy and delivery predictable.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies (daily stand\-up, sprint planning, sprint review/demo, retrospective) for the SFMC squad
* Support backlog grooming and refinement for journeys, campaigns and automations together with business stakeholders
* Track and report sprint/delivery KPIs (velocity, quality, lead time) to the Delivery Manager and Project Committee
* Identify and help remove impediments and dependencies with the Core and Commerce Cloud squads, escalating where required
* Coach the SFMC team on Agile principles, continuous improvement and DevOps best practices
* Support release planning coordination for Marketing Cloud deployments (journeys, data extensions, campaign assets)
* Contribute to the definition and evolution of the Agile working model within the Maison/Division governance


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Proven experience as Scrum Master/Agile Coach for software or marketing\-technology delivery teams, ideally on Salesforce Marketing Cloud or similar platforms
* Strong facilitation, communication and conflict\-resolution skills
* Experience with Agile tooling (JIRA, Azure DevOps) for sprint and backlog management
* Working understanding of Marketing Cloud concepts (journeys, campaigns, data extensions) to engage credibly with the technical team
* Good written and spoken English


**Preferred / Nice To Have**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) certification
* SAFe or other scaled\-agile framework certification


* 
+ Experience supporting multi\-market, multi\-language marketing operations

 **Fulltime** 
 position based in
 **Bengaluru** 
 .

* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country\-dependent)

title: Manager, Technical Professional Services
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Manager, Technical Professional Services
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

title: Release Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, we’re embarking on a Digital Transformation journey, delivering world\-class Direct\-to\-Consumer (D2C) solutions through our Consumer Direct Interaction Organization (CDI XO). As part of a Delivery team embedded at a Digital Product Organization, we are looking for a skilled Release Manager to join our dynamic team, supporting our growth across Europe, APAC, and the Americas. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in ensuring the quality of our cutting\-edge solutions, all while working in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment across multiple Agile Release Trains.
   

  

 We operate in a fast\-paced environment where timing is critical. When a timeline is committed, it is essential that we deliver on time. Delays in delivery can have a direct impact on our company targets and overall success, so timely execution and adherence to schedules is a key component of our delivery initiatives.
   

  

 If you have a passion for delivering successful releases, a background in driving release planning and execution for large\-scale E\-Commerce/CRM/ERP/Cloud Native in\-house digital products, thriving in a fast\-paced digital transformation environment, we want you to be a part of our journey.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 Our mission as the Delivery team within CDI XO is to
 *"enable
 **smooth deliveries***
*of high\-quality digital products on
 **time and budget** 
 in CDI XO, providing
 **transparency** 
 to CAs and CDI stakeholders throughout the software delivery life\-cycle."*
 Therefore as a Release Manager within our Digital Product Organization, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring smooth, timely, uneventful releases across multiple Agile Release Trains in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
   

  

 This position is a mix of:
   

  

* Hands\-on technical leader – requiring constant deep dives into systems, developing extensive knowledge of the technology architecture, and ensuring robust release processes.
* People leader – leading and mentoring a team of Release Engineers who manage technology\-specific releases, fostering collaboration and accountability across the delivery pipeline.


 Core Aspects of Release Management in Our Organization:
   

  

* Communication – Ensure transparency by generating clear release notes for any release exposing features to business or consumers.
* Calendar – Maintenance of a consolidated up\-to\-date release calendar, including freeze periods, enabling proper planning across all product teams.
* Execution – Orchestration of complex technical releases since planning until post go\-live validations, as well as dependency and resource management.
* Operational Efficiency – Continuous exploration of opportunities for automation with Engineering Org to reduce lead time of release execution.
* Governance – Establishment and enforcement of clear guidelines to enable smooth operations and uneventful releases.


**About the CDI Experience Organization:**
 The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end\-users and consumers across both pre\-purchase and post\-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15\+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E\-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. You will play a key role in ensuring the right sizing, right skillset, and core competency across these product areas.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Perform deep and long\-term planning of a consolidated CDI XO Release calendar by aligning with all application owners expected release windows, blackout periods, taking into considerations business critical periods, such as Black Friday/Christmas.
* Own and manage the release planning, scheduling, and execution across digital product teams.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, Processes Owners, Tech Leads, Engineering Managers and Delivery Leads to ensure alignment on release timelines.
* Lead and mentor Release Engineers, providing guidance on best practices and career development.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact delivery schedules or product quality.
* Drive continuous improvement in release processes, ensuring efficiency and predictability.
* Act as the central point of contact for release communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned.
* Monitor release performance metrics and provide insights to leadership for decision\-making.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards and governance for all releases.


**Who are you:**
* Proven experience (5\+ years) in Release Management, Delivery Management, or Project Management within digital product organizations.
* Solid experience in driving release planning and execution, preferably in a multiple technology domain such as E\-commerce/CRM/ERP rollouts.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in a SAFe environment.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability of making multiple tactical/operational decisions on a daily basis.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment where timely execution is critical.
* Experience working with global teams across multiple regions (Europe, APAC, Americas) is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and CI/CD pipelines is highly desirable.
* Sporadic need to cover business critical releases out of regular business hours.


**Where you'll be:**
 This is a full\-time position, based in Bangalore, India
   

  

**Benefits Highlights:**
* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award\-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family\-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

**Description**
 Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance.  Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

 The
 **Senior Business Systems Analyst** 
 serves as a critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams.
 **This role is responsible for translating business needs into detailed, testable technical requirements for both user interface (UI) and API development work.**
 In addition to core business analysis responsibilities, this position performs hands\-on quality assurance activities, including test case creation, execution, defect documentation, and validation of system functionality. The ideal candidate is highly detail\-oriented, excels at clarifying ambiguity, and ensures that delivered solutions align precisely with documented requirements.
   

  

 This role operates in a collaborative Agile environment and partners closely with product owners, developers, and QA to ensure successful delivery of high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and non\-functional requirements
* Translate business needs into clear, structured user stories with detailed acceptance criteria
* Create clear and succinct technical requirements for:
+ User Interface (UI) components, workflows, validations, and user interactions
+ API functionality, including request/response structures, data mappings, business rules, and integration requirements

* Develop process flows, use cases, data mappings, and system documentation to support development efforts
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, and traceable through the development lifecycle
* Facilitate story grooming with engineers and QAs
* Review completed work to confirm alignment with documented requirements
* Collaborate with QA to develop test strategies, test plans, and detailed test cases based on documented requirements
* As needed, execute functional, integration, and regression testing
* Validate UI behavior, data flows, and API responses against defined specifications
* Perform data validation and basic query analysis using SQL to ensure accuracy and completeness
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios and assisting business users


**What You Will Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or in a hybrid BA/QA role
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications for both UI and API development
* Hands\-on experience writing and executing test cases
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, data flows, and system integrations
* Working knowledge of SQL and ability to validate and analyze data
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and requirements documentation tools
* Strong analytical, documentation, and organizational skills, with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**What Will Set You Apart**
* Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
* Experience in financial services or other regulated environments
* Comfort working closely with developers while maintaining an independent validation perspective
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
* A proactive approach to identifying requirement gaps and edge cases

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re\-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500\. Some of the world’s most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally.
   

  

 We’re looking for a SDE III to join Esper, who will be part of a team building Esper’s flagship product, the Esper Foundation for Android, a custom Android\-based operating system built for enterprises, optimized for dedicated Android devices.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer working with the Esper Foundation team, you will play a crucial role in the development, customization, and enhancement of our Android\-based platforms. You will be responsible for designing and implementing software solutions, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and driving the technical direction of Foundation.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* xTS Testing: Lead the design, execution, and management of CTS, VTS, and GTS testing to ensure Android compatibility, security, and performance compliance across all Foundation platforms
* Issue Diagnosis \& Resolution: Investigate, analyze, and resolve test failures by collaborating with fellow engineers, ensuring quick resolution and minimal release delays
* Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain detailed documentation of test cases, execution results, and defect analysis to support continuous improvement and accountability
* Development and Customization: Outside of the primary charter of leading our testing and automation efforts, assist with development of the Esper Foundation for Android product at multiple levels of the stack
* Technical Ownership: Complete technical ownership on some of the Foundation components. Also, become the Subject Matter Expert(SME) for the team.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience
* Experience: 2\-5 years of experience in software development or testing, with a strong focus on Android platform development, AOSP and Android test suites.
* Technical Skills:
* 
+ Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the use of version control systems like Git
+ Proficiency in Java or Kotlin for Android development.
+ Understanding of C/C\+\+ for low\-level programming and system integration.
+ Experience with Android SDK, NDK, and AOSP build systems.
+ Knowledge of Android security architecture and best practices.

* Problem\-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with running Android on x86 hardware or on GSIs is a big plus.
* Experience working at third party, open\-source orgs like LineageOS is a big plus.
* Experience working with CTS tests and building CTS\-compliant Android platforms is desired.
* Experience working on Android OS for GMS certified devices is a huge plus.
* Familiarity with Android Enterprise features and device management APIs and/or experience building Android apps and working in the Enterprise space.
